jobs.title: Software Engineer - Device Control
jobs.description:
Drive design and development of software components to control complex hardware.

#### **About Nearfield Instruments**

Nearfield Instruments (NFI) is a fast-growing scale-up high-tech company. We design, develop, integrate, market and service advanced metrology machines. Our machines enables our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers – to increase the production yields, and thus, functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics.

Founded in 2016, we bring together the most creative minds (approx. 320 employees) in science and technology and develop a one-of-a-kind, revolutionary high throughput Scanning Probe Microscopy system.

Accelerating quality testing is essential for chipmakers to meet the soaring demand for computing capabilities. To meet this need, Nearfield Instruments has developed revolutionary metrology machines. As a (Senior) Software Engineer for Device Control, you will help us write software that drives these machines. Would you like to work at the forefront of metrology innovations while rapidly growing your career? Join us and experience the direct impact that your work has on our and our clients’ performance.

#### **Who you’ll be working with**

Within our Design & Engineering department this role is part of the Software Group. This SW Group consists of 5 teams (Architectural, Machine Control, Device Control, Data Science, Integration & Support).

You will join the Device Control team consisting of software engineers with a diverse range of knowledge such as embedded software, motion control and PLC software.

#### **What you’re going to do**

* Lead a wide range of software development aspects from design to production
* Collaborate closely with other disciplines such as mechatronics and production
* Design and implement software components to control complex hardware
* Write and maintain high quality, testable and efficient code
* Support our customer support and production engineers with their software related questions
* Initiate and promote new ideas for continuous improvement of the product
* Work independently and as a team member (sometimes on a global scale)

#### **Who you are**

* Education: Masters or Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems or a related field.
* Experience: A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in software development with a strong foundation in Design/Architecture, Software Testing, and Software Integration.
* Knowledge: Machine Vision / Computer Vision, Object recognition and Signal Processing knowledge are a plus.
* Background: Previous experience in the semiconductors industry is also a plus.

#### **Skills:**

* Coding/Design/Quality: Proficient in C#, Python, with a deep understanding of OOP Design and Unit Testing.
* Source Control and Configuration: Hands-on experience with Git, as well as familiarity with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) practices.
* Process and Tracking: Demonstrated experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and practical experience using Jira for project management and tracking.

#### **Apply for the job**

If the above challenges excites you, we encourage you to send us your details using the Apply now button on our career site.

**Our recruitment process:**

* Screening by Recruiter.
* Tech assignment.
* 1st interview ( Team Manager + Software Engineer).
* 2nd interview (HRBP + Director of D&E).
* Meeting our CEO.
* Offer.
* Onboarding and welcome at Nearfield Instruments!

If you have any questions? Feel free to contact me via:

#### **Recruitment, consultancy and/or other agency?**

We appreciate the interest, but we source all our candidates directly. We understand that you as an intermediary want to present candidates to our interesting positions. This is not how we have structured our recruitment.

This means that all profiles offered to Nearfield Instruments will be treated as direct applications. Unless we have explicitly agreed otherwise.

jobs.title: Research Software Engineer Geoscience Utrecht
jobs.description:
**About this position**
-----------------------

Do you want to develop software that helps address societal challenges related to the energy transition, sustainable subsurface use, and management of geological hazards? To strengthen our Geomechanics team, we are looking for a Research Software Engineer in Geosciences. In this role, you will work with experts across the Geological Survey of the Netherlands to develop software tools that support research, advice and decision-making in the fields of geothermal energy, subsurface energy storage, subsidence, and induced seismicity.

You will combine your software engineering expertise with a sound understanding of Earth sciences to create robust, user-friendly, and maintainable solutions for a wide range of geoscientific applications. Working on European research projects, national programs, and business-to-business projects, you will help translate scientific ideas and requirements into practical software tools that are used by researchers, project teams, and clients.

**What will be your role?**
---------------------------

As a Research Software Engineer in Geosciences, you will work on multidisciplinary geoscience projects together with researchers and software developers from different teams within the Geological Survey of the Netherlands. You will be based in the Geomechanics team of the Geo Science & Technology department and collaborate with experts who use software and computational tools in a wide range of Earth science applications.

Your primary focus will be the development, maintenance, and improvement of software tools that support geoscientific research and subsurface evaluation. You will translate scientific and technical requirements into robust, scalable, and well-documented software solutions. These tools should be intuitive, maintainable, and suitable for use both within and outside TNO.

You will contribute to projects related to geothermal energy, subsurface energy storage, subsidence, and induced seismicity. Working closely with geoscientists and fellow software developers, you will help improve existing tools, implement new functionality, and apply modern software development practices to scientific applications.

Reporting and presenting your work to colleagues, project partners, and clients will be an important part of the role, as will contributing to technical documentation and scientific publications.

**Key responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and improve software tools for geoscience and subsurface applications.
* Design and implement scalable, reusable, and well-documented code.
* Translate scientific and technical requirements into robust and user-friendly software solutions.
* Improve and automate existing workflows and software tools used in research and consultancy projects.
* Collaborate with geoscientists, software engineers, and project partners in multidisciplinary teams.
* Contribute to software quality through testing, version control, documentation, and code reviews.
* Support the integration of modern technologies and approaches in scientific software development.
* Present results and software developments through reports, presentations, and technical documentation.
* Contribute to scientific publications and dissemination of research outcomes where relevant.

**What we expect from you**
---------------------------

You enjoy working in multidisciplinary project teams and are motivated by combining software development with scientific research and real-world applications. You are curious, proactive, and enjoy tackling complex technical challenges together with domain experts.

You will work closely with geoscientists, software engineers, and other specialists on a diverse portfolio of projects. Alongside software development, you will contribute to reporting, presentations, and technical documentation. You enjoy working in an applied scientific environment and are able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

As you will collaborate with international colleagues and partners, you are able to communicate effectively in English.

**What else do you bring?**

* An MSc or PhD in Earth Sciences, Geosciences, Geophysics, or a related discipline.
* Strong coding, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including proven interest in and experience with object-oriented programming, preferably in Python and/or Java.
* Experience developing clear, maintainable, and well-documented software for scientific or technical applications.
* Affinity with scientific computing and the application of software solutions to geoscientific problems.
* Experience with machine learning techniques, parallel computing, databases, APIs, and web development is considered an advantage.
* Ability to work independently, responsibly, in a results-driven manner, with a proactive attitude and willingness to learn and explore new technologies.
* Ability to write high-quality technical documentation, reports, and scientific publications.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Interest in both research and business-to-business consultancy projects.

**What you'll get in return**
-----------------------------

Challenging and varied work with a real impact. And plenty of opportunities as, at TNO, you are in charge of shaping your career. We offer a gross monthly salary between € 4,800 and € 6,800 (based on your knowledge and experience), 8% holiday pay, a 13th month bonus of 8.33% and a flex budget (5.58% + € 180). In addition, you will be given every opportunity to develop yourself.

TNO offers optional employee benefits, enabling you to tailor your benefits package to match your personal situation. You may also expect:

* An extremely professional, innovative working environment where colleagues are leading experts in their field.
* The opportunity to attend courses, workshops and conferences, and to receive training and coaching based on your needs.
* 33 days annual leave plus a flexi

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer Industriële Automatisering
jobs.description:
### **HIGHLIGHTS VAN DEZE VACATURE**

✔ Werken aan de automatisering van grote fabrieksprocessen, weg uit puur theoretische engineering. ✔ Programmeren van DCS-, PLC- en SCADA-software voor chemie-, food- en energieprojecten. ✔ Leren van ervaren engineers binnen een team van 30 collega's in Amsterdam, met een operations manager die zelf als engineer begon.

### **DIT GA JE DOEN**

Als Junior Software Engineer Industriële Automatisering werk je mee aan het automatiseren en moderniseren van productieprocessen bij grote fabrieken in onder andere de chemie, food en farmacie. Daarnaast werk je aan automatiseringsprojecten voor energie-infrastructuur, zoals grote windmolenparken op zee en op land. Je ontwikkelt software waarmee complete installaties veilig, stabiel en efficiënt draaien, van de onderliggende proceslogica tot de bediening door operators in de controlekamer. Je doet dit binnen een ervaren system integrator, waar je samen met senior collega’s werkt aan maatwerkoplossingen en stap voor stap meer verantwoordelijkheid krijgt in ontwerp, realisatie, testen en inbedrijfstelling. Zo groei je door tot een volwaardige Software Engineer Industriële Automatisering met een duidelijk aandeel in de technische keuzes binnen projecten. In grote lijnen ga je aan de slag met de volgende werkzaamheden:

  

* Meewerken aan automatiseringsprojecten voor procesinstallaties in de chemie, food, farmacie en voor energieprojecten zoals windmolenparken op zee.
* Vertalen van proces- en bedieningswensen naar functionele ontwerpen en technische documentatie.
* Programmeren van software voor PLC-, SCADA-, DCS- en HMI-systemen met platforms als Siemens PCS7, ABB, Rockwell, WinCC en iFIX.
* Ontwerpen van overzichtelijke en gebruiksvriendelijke operatorinterfaces voor controlekamers en lokale bedieningspanelen.
* Uitvoeren van testen en ondersteunen bij inbedrijfstelling van nieuwe of gemoderniseerde installaties op klantlocatie.

Door de groei van het aantal projecten in de procesindustrie én de toenemende vraag vanuit de energiesector, werk je aan migraties van verouderde besturingssystemen en nieuwe greenfield-projecten. Hierdoor stap je als Junior Software Engineer Industriële Automatisering nu in op een moment met veel leermogelijkheden, techniekvernieuwing en zichtbare impact op zowel industriële als infrastructurele projecten.

### **DIT BRENG JE MEE**

Je werkt gestructureerd, stelt gerichte vragen en vindt het logisch om eerst de proceslogica te begrijpen voordat je code schrijft, terwijl je ook graag samenwerkt met collega-engineers om tot een goed werkende oplossing te komen.  

* Je hebt een hbo-diploma in Elektrotechniek, Industriële Automatisering, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare technische richting.
* Bij voorkeur heb je al eerste ervaring opgedaan met industriële automatisering via stages of schoolprojecten.
* Je hebt interesse in procesindustrie en industriële besturingssystemen zoals PLC, SCADA en DCS.

### **HIER KUN JE OP REKENEN**

Deze functie als Junior Software Engineer Industriële Automatisering biedt je de volgende arbeidsvoorwaarden.

  

* Een startsalaris tussen € 3.300,00 tot € 3.750,00 bruto per maand.
* 28 vakantiedagen per jaar.
* Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 per kilometer en uitzicht op een auto van de zaak.
* Een jaarlijkse winstuitkering afhankelijk van de resultaten.
* Flexibele werktijden met de mogelijkheid om geregeld vanuit huis te werken.
* 8% vakantiegeld.
* Werkgeversbijdrage van 2/3de aan het pensioen.

Daarnaast zijn er nog meer voorwaarden, zoals goede IT-middelen en opleidingsmogelijkheden, die we graag verder toelichten in een persoonlijk gesprek. Reageer direct als deze functie als Junior Software Engineer Industriële Automatisering past bij wat jij zoekt. Je krijgt altijd binnen 1 werkdag een reactie. Neem bij vragen contact op met Milan van den Bosch via 06 - 43 27 44 00.

### **HIER GA JE WERKEN**

Je gaat aan de slag bij een gespecialiseerde system integrator in de industriële automatisering. De organisatie is internationaal actief en telt wereldwijd honderden engineers, maar het team in Amsterdam is bewust klein en overzichtelijk. Je profiteert van de voordelen van een grote organisatie, zoals veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden, moderne tools en kennisdeling over de vestigingen heen. Tegelijk werk je lokaal in een hecht team met korte lijnen.

In Amsterdam werk je samen met ongeveer 30 collega’s, voornamelijk engineers en consultants, in een omgeving waar inhoudelijke samenwerking en kennisdeling centraal staan. De sfeer is professioneel en informeel tegelijk, collega’s kennen elkaar goed en trekken in projecten gezamenlijk op richting de klant. De operations manager van deze vestiging is zelf ooit begonnen als engineer. Hij kent de techniek en de praktijk, en is inhoudelijk sparringpartner voor het team. Dit laat ook zien dat doorgroei binnen de organisatie aantoonbaar mogelijk is. Je werkplek is ingericht op geconcentreerde engineering, overleg met collega’s en de voorbereiding op testen en inbedrijfstellingen bij klanten.

jobs.title: Front End/Middleware Software Engineer - Terberg Automotive
jobs.description:
**Front End/Middleware Software Engineer (32–40 uur per week)**

  

Terberg Automotive is op zoek naar een Front End/Middleware Software Engineer.

Ben jij een ervaren developer met kennis van moderne frontend- en middlewaretechnologieën? Krijg je energie van het ontwerpen, bouwen en verbeteren van softwareapplicaties? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

  

**Wat ga je doen?**

Als Front End/Middleware Software Engineer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van onze softwareapplicaties. Je werkt aan front-end oplossingen en webbased systemen die bijdragen aan onze Connected Services. Samen met het team vertaal je functionele wensen naar toekomstbestendige en hoogwaardige software.

  

**Jouw taken:**

* Analyseren van de behoefte aan nieuwe functionaliteiten
* Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van nieuwe functionaliteiten en uitbreiden van bestaande systemen.
* Actief doen van verbetervoorstellen ter optimalisatie van onze applicaties.
* Ontwikkelen van (webbased) frontend-oplossingen binnen onze Connected Services‑omgeving.
* Zelfstandig bijdragen aan zowel front-end als middlewarecomponenten.
* Werken met moderne technologieën zoals Blazor, CSS/JavaScript/HTML5 en C#.
* Onderhouden en verbeteren van softwarearchitectuur en technische documentatie.
* Rapporteren aan de Team Lead Connected Services binnen de afdeling Development & Engineering.

  

**Wie jij bent**

Jij bent analytisch sterk, gestructureerd en hebt passie voor softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt graag samen binnen een technisch team, maar kunt ook zelfstandig uitstekend uit de voeten. Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe functionaliteit te creëren en zoekt actief naar manieren om onze systemen beter, sneller en slimmer te maken.

  

De meest ideale kandidaat heeft/is:

* Aantoonbare werkervaring met Blazor
* Ervaring met CSS/JavaScript/HTML5
* Ervaring met C#
* Kennis van Angular of ASP.NET is een pré
* Ervaring of affiniteit met Azure cloudoplossingen
* Analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en kwaliteitsgericht
* Proactieve houding en in staat om complexe technische verbanden te herkennen

  

Voldoe je niet volledig aan alle punten, maar ben je wél gemotiveerd om jezelf te ontwikkelen? Dan nodigen we je van harte uit om te solliciteren.

  

**Wat wij jou bieden**

Je wordt onderdeel van een internationaal opererend familiebedrijf waar je gezien wordt en jezelf kunt zijn. Daarnaast ontvang je bij ons:

  

* Een salaris van € 3.900 tot € 5.700 (afhankelijk van je leeftijd en ervaring).
* 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV dagen op basis van fulltime dienstverband (40 uur/week).
* Reiskostenvergoeding
* Deelname aan het pensioenfonds via PMT
* Diverse opleidingsmogelijkheden
* Actieve personeelsvereniging

  

**Waar je terecht komt**

Terberg Automotive is gevestigd in IJsselstein en onderdeel van de Royal Terberg Group.

Binnen de Royal Terberg Group levert Terberg Automotive geavanceerde software- en hardware oplossingen voor de automotive sector. Veel Terberg producten zijn verbonden door ons product; Terberg Connect! Onder één dak ontwikkelen we software, werken aan systeemintegratie en bedenken én maken elektronische modules. Een enthousiast team focust zich op goede samenwerking om zichzelf continue te verbeteren en te innoveren. We zijn wereldwijd actief en in het leveren van oplossingen die de efficiëntie en duurzaamheid van Terberg producten bevorderen.

Toch zijn we nog steeds gewoon een Nederlands familiebedrijf met korte lijnen, waar je als medewerker echt gezien wordt. Met onze familiewaarden als uitgangspunt werken we bij Terberg op een eerlijke en betrouwbare manier. Wij investeren graag in onze mensen door middel van trainingen, het bieden van een veilige werkplek, fijne werksfeer en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden. Dat wordt ook gewaardeerd door onze medewerkers. Veel collega’s werken al jarenlang met veel plezier bij ons.

  

*Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Wij werven graag rechtstreeks.*

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Junior Software Engineer**

Amsterdam **32–40 uur**

Axini maakt een geavanceerd model-driven softwareplatform waarmee organisaties sneller en foutloos software ontwikkelen en testen. Ons platform groeit hard en we zoeken een leergierige, allround Junior Software Engineer die theorie en techniek wil combineren met directe klantimpact.

Bij ons vind je diepgang in algoritmen, formele talen en AI, slimme collega’s en volop ruimte voor je eigen inbreng. Wil jij meebouwen aan de toekomst van software engineering, sparren met klanten en jezelf continu blijven ontwikkelen? Dan horen we graag van je.

**Over Axini**

Axini is van oorsprong een spin-off van de Universiteit Twente. Ons doel is de volgende generatie software development mogelijk te maken: vergaande automatisering dankzij ons platform voor model-driven engineering. We zitten in de scale-upfase: onze producten hebben zich bewezen en we schalen nu onze klantenkring en organisatie op.

Je kunt ons platform zien als een krachtige oplossing waarin specificaties worden vastgelegd in formele talen. Onze algoritmen kunnen automatisch redeneren over specificaties, testgevallen afleiden en code genereren. Hiermee helpen we bijvoorbeeld ProRail om real-time systemen te verifiëren die treinen 24/7 laten rijden, en Achmea om flexibel en foutvrij financiële processen te automatiseren.

Bij Axini vind je uitdagende software engineering puzzels, klanten die focus en pragmatiek vragen, veel variatie en een team dat je scherp houdt en inspireert.

**De functie**

Als Junior Software Engineer groei je toe naar het overzien van het volledige ontwikkelproces van ons SaaS-platform: van requirements en architectuur tot implementatie, maintenance en cloud-ops. Van back-end tot front-end.

In deze rol combineer je het beste van twee werelden: diepe techniek én regelmatig contact met de mensen voor wie je het bouwt. Je vindt het leuk om actief met klanten in gesprek te gaan:

* Je helpt klanten en partners bij het aansluiten van ons platform op hun systemen.
* Je ondersteunt hen bij het modelleren van processen en geeft concrete training en overdracht.
* Je werkt mee aan innovatieve features waarin we moderne AI-tooling en LLM’s praktisch inzetten om modelleren en testen voor onze gebruikers nóg eenvoudiger te maken.
* Je denkt mee over de doorontwikkeling van onze DSL’s, modelleeromgeving, constraint solving, symbolische transitiesystemen en andere grensverleggende technieken.

We werken voornamelijk met Ruby en wat Rails; ervaring hiermee is geen vereiste, zolang je leergierig bent. Je ontwikkelt onder Ubuntu met een editor naar eigen keuze.

**Wat verwachten we van jou?**

Productsoftware bouwen vraagt om vakmanschap: code schrijven die modulair, begrijpelijk en solide is. Maar minstens zo belangrijk is je nieuwsgierigheid en je plezier in menselijk contact.

* Opleiding & denkvermogen: Een afgeronde universitaire opleiding in Informatica, Software Engineering of een vergelijkbare richting (of aantoonbaar academisch werk- en denkniveau).
* Nieuwsgierig naar AI: Je volgt de ontwikkelingen rondom AI met veel interesse. Je experimenteert er graag mee (tijdens je studie, in projecten of met moderne AI-tools) en ziet de kansen om AI praktisch in te zetten binnen software engineering.
* Klantgericht en communicatief: Je vindt het oprecht leuk om met klanten te communiceren, te luisteren naar hun behoeften en complexe concepten helder en rustig uit te leggen.
* Talen: Goede beheersing van zowel het Nederlands (onze klantenkring is grotendeels Nederlandstalig) als het Engels (onze interne voertaal).

**Wat bieden we?**

* Salaris: Een marktconform salaris € 3.200 - € 3.800 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je achtergrond en ervaring. Een regeling waarbij je vanaf 1 jaar dienstverband meeprofiteert wanneer aandelen van Axini worden verkocht.
* Pensioen & reiskosten: Een goede pensioenbijdrage en volledige reiskostenvergoeding
* Persoonlijke groei: Een halve dag per week gereserveerd voor je eigen langetermijnontwikkeling en research
* Cultuur & team: Een hecht en slim team van circa 20 mensen, inclusief hackathon-weken, lunchpresentaties en een actieve boekenclub
* Flexibiliteit & balans: Hybride werken. Gemiddeld 1 dag per week op ons kantoor in Amsterdam, de overige dagen flexibel vanuit huis (en af en toe bij de klant). We sturen op output en houden realistische planningen aan, zonder structureel overwerk.
* Hardware: Goede laptop en faciliteiten voor een fijne thuiswerkplek

**Hoe ziet een typische week eruit?**

Dit zou een week kunnen zijn uit de agenda van iemand die een jaar bij Axini werkt:

* Maandag: Veel gezamenlijke afstemming voor focus in de rest van de week. Weekstart met het projectteam, om 11:45 uur de stand-up. In de middag een demo/retro en sparren voor het whiteboard over een nieuw architectuurvraagstuk.
* Dinsdag (thuis): Implementatie en unittests voor een nieuwe platformfeature. In de middag help je via een videocall een klant een uurtje op weg met modelleren.
* Woensdag (kantoor): Code-review met een collega, sparren met een afstudeerder en aan het einde van de middag je kwartaaldoelen en ontwikkeling doornemen met je mentor.
* Donderdag (thuis): Werken aan een lopend klantproject: hertesten van een release en twee bevindingen documenteren en bespreken.
* Vrijdag (thuis): De ochtend besteed je aan je innovatiedagdeel (je verdiepen in een nieuwe AI-tooling of taal). In de middag pair program je samen met een collega.

**Solliciteren**

Heb je vragen over de vacature of wil je informeel kennismaken? Neem contact op met Ruben Reijers:

* E-mail: jobs@axini.com

Acquisitie n.a.v. deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

*Het proces:*

* Stuur je cv en een korte motivatie naar jobs@axini.com: wat spreekt je aan in Axini en deze rol?
* Eerste kennismakingsgesprek (online of op kantoor).
* Een praktijkopdracht die representatief is voor het werk bij Axini, gevolgd door een inhoudelijke nabespreking.
* Een aanbod en welkom aan

jobs.title: Research Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Tilburg University | Library & IT Services**

is looking for a

  

**Research Software Engineer**

  

Department: IT Development, Team Tilburg AI

On site: Tilburg

Contract size: 0,7 – 1.0fte fte (28 - 40 hours per week)

Full-time gross monthly salary: €3.873 - €5.264

Contract duration: 12 - 48 months

Intended start date: November 1st 2026

Would you like to build open-source software that helps researchers make their work more transparent, verifiable, and reusable?

  

Tilburg University is looking for a Research Software Engineer for **ReproHub**, a large-scale open science infrastructure project funded by OpenScienceNL/NWO. In this role, you will work with researchers, research software engineers, library experts, student developers, Tilburg University’s AI development and cloud team (tilburg.ai), and national partners such as ODISSEI.

  

ReproHub develops infrastructure for researchers working with secondary and sensitive data. The project builds on existing Dutch open science infrastructure, including ODISSEI and Tilburg Science Hub, and aims to strengthen reproducibility, transparency, and public trust in science.

  

**Your position**

As a research software engineer based at Library & Information Services at Tilburg University, you will contribute to the technical development and integration of ReproHub, a large-scale open science infrastructure project recently funded by OpenScienceNL/NWO. Specifically, you will be part of the project’s technical development team and help translate stakeholder needs into reliable, maintainable, and secure software.

  

ReproHub (see project proposal for details) consists of four connected deliverables:

* ReproBuddy: an AI tool based on open-source LLMs to improve reproducibility packages using commonly used workflows in the social sciences
* ReproRun: a system to validate research results and provide certificates
* OpenScienceRadar: a browser extension that makes open resources from public databases visible alongside search results (e.g., in Google Search)
* OpenScienceHub.nl: scaling Tilburg Science Hub to become a national platform with accessible educational material on Dutch and European open science infrastructure
  

Important activities include:

* Developing frontend and backend components for ReproHub’s tools and services;
* designing, building, and maintaining APIs and integrations between the different components;
* Contributing to API-based integration of LLM functionality, including context-retrieval approaches and open-source large language models;
* Helping build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployment workflows, and Kubernetes-based deployment;
* Developing and improving user interfaces for researchers, research support staff, and other users;
* Reviewing code, auditing pull requests, and maintaining technical documentation;
* Collaborating with student assistants and supporting them in writing high-quality, maintainable code;
* Translating stakeholder needs into technical choices, prototypes, and production-ready solutions;
* Contributing to software quality, security, privacy, reproducibility, and responsible AI practices.
  

**Your profile**

* Ability to work and think at an academic or bachelor level

* At least 1 year of relevant experience as a full-stack developer, software engineer, research software engineer, or similar.

* Minimum CEFR level C1 English and B2 Dutch.

* Comfortable building web applications with Python and modern frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, or comparable frameworks, and has experience with Git-based workflows, code review, and writing clean, maintainable code.

* Experience with API-based integration of LLM functionality, ideally including retrieval-augmented generation or related context-retrieval approaches, working with open-source large language models, and connecting AI components to web applications or research tools.

* Experience with, or willingness to learn, technical infrastructure such as Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, cloud deployment, monitoring, and secure software development practices.

* Understanding the importance of software quality, security, privacy, reproducibility, and responsible technology use, especially in research and open science contexts.

* Enjoys working in a multidisciplinary team with researchers, developers, library experts, IT colleagues, and student assistants, and can translate user needs into practical technical solutions.

* Is accurate, curious, pragmatic, and communicative; takes ownership of technical work while remaining open to feedback from users and colleagues.

* Experience with open-source projects, research data workflows, browser extension development, university IT environments, or Dutch language skills is an advantage.

**Our offer**

Tilburg University offers excellent benefits in a pleasant working environment:

* Employment of 0.7 – 1.0 fte (28 - 40 hours per week).
* Salary between €3.873 - €5.264 gross per month for full-time employment (UFO-profile Engineering & Application Manager 4, salary scale 9). Tilburg University uses a neutral remuneration system based on relevant work experience.
* This is a vacancy whose work is temporarily externally funded by NWO, You will be given a temporary contract for the duration of 12 months, which can be continued for a maximum duration of up to 48 months.
* Vacation pay of 8% and a year-end bonus of 8.3%.
* Over 8 weeks of vacation leave.
* Hybrid working with home working allowance (€2 p/day) and internet allowance (€25 p/month).
* Reimbursement of sustainable commuting: walking, cycling, and public transport.
* Options model for additional leave, pension, bicycle or personal training.
* Moving allowance (subject to conditions).
* 30% rule for international employees (if applicable).
* Pension through ABP.
* Ample training offer: personal development, leadership, education, research or language courses.
* Inclusive work culture: everyone welcome, equal

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Fulfilment & Core Services, Group Digital, Amsterdam
jobs.description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

* Location

  Amsterdam
* Employment type

  Full Time Permanent
* Department

  IT & Digital Solutions
* Deadline

  2026-10-16

  

Candidate profile (title) What you need to know

Candidate profile (text) - Default language We are creating a better everyday life for the many people, and we need your help to do it!
  
  
IKEA is in an expansion phase - opening new stores, trying out new formats and reshaping our current assets to reach more of the many people. Our Expansion team builds the critical tools and systems that make this possible, supporting Retail Expansion and Real Estate teams as they bring IKEA to new communities around the world.
  
  
Right now, we're at an exciting inflection point. We're taking ownership and building internal capability, moving from external teams to empowered internal team. This means you'll have the opportunity to truly shape how we work, what we build, and how we deliver value to our users.
  
  
We have opportunities across two key areas:
  

* Established systems: Working on tools that support the expansion process and insights management - modernizing, simplifying, and building better experiences for our users
* Greenfield discovery: Joining us in the early exploration phase where we're still defining what to build - involving discovery work, stakeholder interviews, needs mapping, and software architecture design.

  
If you want to work on one of the most important business problems for IKEA right now, this is the team to join!

Key responsibilities (title) Who you are

Key responsibilities (text) You are a full stack engineer who is ready to take ownership and thrive in an environment where we're building internal capability from the ground up. You're someone who can think independently, make decisions, and help establish the foundations for how we work.
  
  
You're excited about technology and want to build digital products that have real impact -helping IKEA expand its physical presence across the world. You understand that great software isn't just about code; it's about understanding users, solving real problems, and delivering value.
  
  
You relish the opportunity to contribute to both team metrics and product metrics. You'll be part of defining how and what we measure to define success from an engineering perspective. If you have a few years of experience building backend applications and are ready to take on more ownership and responsibility in a transformative environment – we want to hear from you!
  
  
In this role, you will design and build reliable interfaces that connect in-store automation systems with our core platforms, ensuring smooth and real-time data flow. You’ll work closely with hardware vendors, store operations teams, and other engineering teams to deliver secure, high-quality integrations that keep our stores running efficiently.

Team vision ( title) About this work area

Team vision (text) Our team works cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Data. We expect all team members to contribute to good software design principles and keep each other accountable. We use these principles to guide us when exploring new solutions, bringing in new tools and frameworks, or creating entirely new systems.
  
  
We work primarily on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and are actively modernizing our systems with Infrastructure as Code with Terraform. Most of our systems are only a few years old, giving us a modern foundation to build upon.
  
  
For the frontend we use React with JS, we have our own design system, you probably already know it from www.ikea.com, which is the better example. We do have also a version of it for our coworkers, so internal tools also benefit from having a proper design.
  
  
For the backend we mostly use Node JS, with containers on GCP deploying serverless. It allows us to keep same language for frontend and backend which makes easier to engineers work on both sides of the apps. We use lot of fun stuff, with CDNs tech like Edge Computing and distributed caching, but also good old databases, with NoSQL and SQL approaches, event driving architecture, REST, and many other web technologies that we align in our Engineering baseline. You will also have access to latest AI models and tools to help you; we are fully onboard with AI but taking a human-centric approach. You can learn more about IKEA Responsible AI, by searching online.

Let's connect Questions and support? Let's connect!

Let´s connect Please note that due to GDPR reasons, we do not accept applications by email, and want you to send us your CV in English. We look forward to receiving your application and will review candidates continuously, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

### **What we all have in common**

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

Being specialized in alcoholic beverages, we offer a full range of transportation services and options, from full container loads to groupage shipments, from large volumes of bulk wine to small consignments via airfreight. Our logistics services allow our customers to transport exactly what they want, when they want, in a costeffective way.

To support our continued growth and digital transformation, we are expanding our **software development** team with a **C++/C# developer**. In this role, you will join our software development department of 55+ professionals covering analysis, development, and testing. The team is highly autonomous and works closely with Product Owners to build inhouse, businessdriven applications.

Our architecture is API first, cloudnative, and centered around Microsoft Azure, with Apigee for API management and Okta for identity and access management. We are currently migrating our C++ client server transport management system to this architecture.

You will assist in the C++ development of the current client server application as well as help with the C# rest api backend. At first, the C++ programming will take the majority of your time with a shift towards C# backend development within Azure as the migration project continues on.

jobs.title: Cloud Software Engineer – Managed Kubernetes
jobs.description:
The Container Services team is responsible for delivering Leaseweb Managed Kubernetes a platform that empowers customers to deploy, manage, and update their own Kubernetes clusters while simplifying the complexity that comes with running them at scale. We are looking for a motivated Cloud Software Engineer to help build and evolve this product.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team of experienced professionals (software engineers, system engineers, scrum master, product owner and product management) that strive to make our product better.

**Product Engineering at Leaseweb**

Our team of approximately 145 engineers works in small scrum teams, each with end-to-end responsibility for a specific product or part of our architecture. We work on a remote-first basis, coming together in person at our Amsterdam headquarters twice a year.

Our organizational structure is flat, placing a high value on independence and entrepreneurship. The atmosphere is informal and relaxed, creating a highly motivating work environment where you will work alongside some of the most inspiring colleagues in the industry.

**What is the role about?**

In your role as a Cloud Software Engineer in the Container Services team, you are responsible for designing, developing and maintaining a platform that automates the delivery and management of Kubernetes Cluster for our customers. Your main activity will be working together with the team to design, implement and maintain the components that powers our product.

The components you will work on are responsible for deploying Virtual machines, configuring network, volumes, firewall rules, load-balancing and a lot of cloud-related concepts, making Kubernetes deployment work with Leaseweb Public Cloud.

In your journey, you may have to handle multiple parts of our tech stack: Kubernetes, Golang, Containers, ArgoCD, Helm charts.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop & maintain Kubernetes controllers & operators in Golang.
* Propose innovative solutions to meet the product's needs.
* Research, evaluate & recommend tools or components to improve our product, or satisfy a need.
* Collaborate with the Product Owner and the rest of the agile team to refine Product Backlog Increments & prioritize impactful features.
* Improve & maintain our platform, ensuring high-availability and scalability.
* Troubleshoot, Reproduce, Debug and resolve complex issues.
* Collaborate on open-source projects.
* Regular on-call duty (EOD–Engineer on Duty).

**Who are you?**

You have experience for developing Kubernetes operators in Golang. You are looking for new opportunities. You enjoy building new solutions using the latest technologies. You believe that continuous improvement also applies to yourself and have the desire to grow. You are not afraid to experiment but at the same time keep in mind observability, scalability, stability and reliability.

**Your skill set:**

* Have proven and demonstrable knowledge of programming languages, (e.g. Golang).
* Experience with developing & implementing Kubernetes components (e.g. Operators, Controllers, Custom Resource Definition CRD, Cluster API)
* Experience with creating container images with Docker files, Kubernetes Manifest and Helm charts.
* Experience with Kubernetes and related projects.
* Good knowledge of cloud related concepts, such as networking, storage, and virtualization.
* Able to collaborate with colleagues, perform code review.
* Able to work in a development team using common scrum practices.
* Good communication skills.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Large Kubernetes deployments (measured by number of nodes) and the different tools available in the CNCF landscape.
* Experience with Continuous deployment (e.g. Jenkins, ArgoCD)
* Relevant experience with monitoring / observability tools (e.g. Icinga, Prometheus, Alert Manager, Loki, Grafana).
* Demonstrable knowledge of Linux and operating system internals.
* Experience with automation tools such as (e.g. Chef, Puppet, Ansible, Terraform).
* Previous contributions to open source.
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or similar certification will be considered.

**Benefits include:**

* Participation in annual company bonus scheme and company pension

* Internet allowance and travel allowance

* Working from home policy

* Work from abroad: Up to 4 weeks per year, following policy guidelines

* Lease bike plan

* 25 days of paid time off (and the option to buy or sell up to 5 more days)

* Free lunch, parking, and fresh fruit provided when in the office

* Access to the Leaseweb Academy, a personalized learning platform offering a variety of studies, (Dutch) courses, and trainings

* Attractive relocation packages and an agency that takes care of the entire visa process

* Fun events year-round – from virtual pub quizzes to summer parties, company runs, quarterly hackathons and much more

* A multicultural work environment (our colleagues are from over 60 countries!) in a company where you can truly make a difference

**Ready for the next step?**

If you'd like to apply, please do so online. To learn more about us, follow us on LinkedIn or Instagram to get an inside look at life at Leaseweb. For questions, please reach out to Demetra Spyrou, Talent Acquisition Specialist, at: d.spyrou@global.leaseweb.com.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**We are Last Mile Solutions**

With over 360,000 charging stations and 1.9 million charging cards across 22 countries, Last Mile Solutions is Europe's largest independent e-mobility platform. The scale behind these numbers results in massive real-time data flows and high-volume transaction processing.

Our mission is simplifying the energy transition and creating a sustainable world by turning energy into value.

We're currently searching for a Medior/Senior Backend Software Engineer to join our team in Rotterdam.

**Our core values:**

* **Empowering connections** - *We believe great things happen when people, systems, and energy are connected. We build with that in mind, for our customers, our colleagues, and our platform.*
* **Exploring with purpose** - *Curious by nature, but moving with intent. Experiment, learn and iterate. In service of a clear goal.*
* **Owning our impact -** *We take responsibility for what we build and how it affects the world around us. From code quality to the energy transition.*

**Your role**  
  
As a Backend Software Engineer at Last Mile Solutions, you are a hands-on engineer who takes real ownership of the products your team builds. You work in a compact, fast-growing PHP-focussed engineering team, as PHP is currently our primary backend language. One of our engineering teams works with Go, but this role will primarily involve working with PHP.  
At Last Mile Solutions you will be developing software for the next generation of e-mobility solutions — not just building features, but contributing to a growing platform with all the challenges that come with it.
  
You don’t just write code, you understand the bigger picture. You grasp the connections between systems and the products you are building and you use that understanding to make better engineering decisions. You bring a product mindset to your technical work.

You work closely with your Tech Lead, Product Manager and fellow engineers to design, implement, and operate scalable and reliable backend systems.
  
You're eager to grow your impact over time.

**Your main responsibilities**

* Work on the full lifecycle of your team's products: understanding the underlying problem, designing pragmatic solutions, and implementing, testing, and releasing features.
* Understand the product you are building, not just the code, but the business context, user needs and how your work connects to the broader platform.
* Write high-quality code and ensure quality through thorough testing — including edge cases, performance, and reliability.
* Monitor and operate systems in production, using observability tooling to spot issues and continuously improve reliability.
* Work according to DevSecOps principles: integrating security thinking into your daily engineering work, from design to deployment.
* Collaborate with Platform Engineering to adopt shared systems, improve CI/CD pipelines, and enhance developer experience.
* Work across teams to improve and scale the platform as a whole.
* Embrace and actively adopt AI tooling and practices in your daily workflow.
* Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement — in code, in process, and in craft.
* Depending on the team, the role may involve working in 24/7 shifts or participating in an on-call rotation.

**You recognise yourself in**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or equivalent through experience).
* At least 4 years of work experience as a Backend Software Engineer in an agile, preferably product-led organisation.
* You think in distributed systems. You've designed or maintained asynchronous, event-driven architectures and know how to handle high-throughput, high-load scenarios with confidence. Working with RabbitMQ and or SQS in the cloud feels natural to you, and you understand the trade-offs between different messaging and queuing patterns.
* You're comfortable working across languages. PHP is our primary backend language at the moment.
* Experience with Go is a plus.
* You know your way around relational databases and NoSQL stores like Redis or DynamoDB. You pick the right tool for the job.
* Containers are part of your daily workflow — Docker is a must. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and broader DevOps practices is a genuine plus.
* You have a natural curiosity about the product you’re building. You connect the dots between systems, think beyond your own ticket, and are eager to understand why things are built the way they are.
* You embrace DevSecOps as a mindset: you take ownership of security in your own code and see secure development practices as part of good engineering .
* You're not daunted by legacy code or monoliths — you've refactored and improved long-lived systems and see it as an opportunity.
* You are keen to iterate, improve, and find and resolve performance gaps. You thrive in a fast-paced, fast-growing environment.
* You are proactive, a quick learner, and continuously push yourself to improve.
* You have an excellent command of the English language and you recognise yourself in our core values.

**What we offer**

* A great challenge in the dynamic and sustainable sector of E-Mobility
* Ambitious colleagues as sparring partners
* Training and development opportunities in an international environment
* 25 vacation days and 13 ATV days (38 days total based on full-time)
* A pension plan
* A bonus scheme
* Flexibility in working hours and between remote and office work
* Full reimbursement of public transport costs or a mileage allowance and a parking pass
* A cosy office at a top location in Rotterdam
* Daily free lunch in our rooftop bistro
* Regular social events and sports classes (bootcamp, boxing and pilates)

Interested?

Apply now! If you have any questions, please reach out to recruitment at jobs@lastmilesolutions.com.

*A VOG (Certificate of Conduct)/Screening will be part of the recruitment procedure.*

jobs.title: Controls Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Wat ga je doen**

Bij Meyn Food Processing Technology ontwikkelen wij geavanceerde voedselverwerkingsoplossingen voor de pluimvee-industrie, waarbij wij werktuigbouwkunde, automatisering en software combineren tot intelligente en efficiënte verwerkingslijnen voor klanten wereldwijd. Binnen onze R&D organisatie, Innovation – Plant Automation, ontwikkelen wij de volgende generatie van slimme, verbonden en flexibele machines, en daarvoor zijn wij op zoek naar een ervaren Controls Software Engineer.

In deze rol ben je betrokken bij het elektrisch ontwerp en de volledige software-levenscyclus van onze machinebesturingen, van software-architectuur en PLC-ontwikkeling tot testen, in bedrijf stellen en continue verbetering. Als lid van het PLC & HMI Team ontwikkel je hoogwaardige, modulaire automatiseringssystemen en werk je met standaarden en technologieën zoals IEC 61131, OPC UA, MQTT, XML en EtherCAT. Daarnaast help je onze softwarebibliotheken, standaarden en ontwikkelprocessen te verbeteren, met een sterke focus op betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, prestaties en onderhoudbaarheid.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van de rol is het versnellen van de integratie van smart sensors en IoT-technologieën in Meyn-machines. Je verbindt sensordata met de machinebesturing en hogere systemen, en zet real-time machine- en procesdata om in bruikbare inzichten. Dit omvat het verkennen van nieuwe sensortechnologieën, industriële communicatie en IoT-architecturen om slimmere machines, predictive maintenance, verbeterde prestaties en datagedreven procesoptimalisatie mogelijk te maken. Zo help je de kloof te overbruggen tussen traditionele machinebesturing en de verbonden, intelligente verwerkingslijnen van de toekomst.

Je werkt nauw samen met Chief Engineers, Product Managers, System en Mechanical Engineers en andere specialisten om complexe machineprocessen om te zetten in robuuste automatiseringsoplossingen. Jouw software wordt onderdeel van Meyn’s productportfolio en draait op echte machines en verwerkingslijnen over de hele wereld.

**Wat zoeken wij**

Wij zijn op zoek naar een ervaren industrial automation, mechatronics of software engineer met een sterke achtergrond in elektrisch ontwerp en PLC, een gestructureerde aanpak van technische uitdagingen en een passie voor het ontwikkelen van betrouwbare industriële oplossingen. Wil jij verder gaan dan traditionele PLC-programmering en meebouwen aan de toekomst van Meyns machinebesturingen en smartificatie, dan komen we graag met je in contact.

Daarnaast beschik je over;

* Diepgaande en brede kennis van (industriële) software engineering, IEC61131, OPC-UA, MQTT, XML, EtherCAT
* Ervaring met elektrisch ontwerp, en het bouwen, testen en opleveren van software voor industriële machines
* Een gedegen begrip van beveiliging, prestaties en andere non-functionele software-eigenschappen
* Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk
* Rijbewijs
* Reisbereidheid

**Wat bieden wij**

* Salaris tussen € 4.160,00 en € 6.026,00, afhankelijk van opleiding en werkervaring
* Flexibele werktijden: mogelijkheid om te starten tussen 7:00 en 9:30 uur
* Aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling
* Ruime verlofregeling: 33 dagen in totaal, bestaande uit 25 vakantiedagen en 8 ADV-dagen
* Groei- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden: volop kansen voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en carrièregroei
* Flexibele werkregelingen: mogelijkheid om één dag per week thuis te werken
* Reiskostenvergoeding: €0,25 per kilometer

**Over Meyn**

Al meer dan 65 jaar is Meyn een vertrouwde wereldwijde marktleider in oplossingen voor de pluimveeverwerking. Als Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) ontwerpen en bouwen wij onze eigen machines en systemen, die door klanten wereldwijd worden gebruikt. Door bij Meyn te komen werken, word je onderdeel van een team dat wordt gedreven door innovatie, samenwerking en een continu streven naar excellentie. Solliciteer nu en word onderdeel van een team dat succes drijft.

**Interesse**

Solliciteer via de sollicitatieknop. Heb je vragen over deze vacature? Neem dan contact op met Maik Litjens, Corporate Recruiter, via mlitjens@meyn.com

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Internship | Summer '27
jobs.description:
**About BlockTech**

BlockTech is a fast-paced algorithmic market maker facilitating global derivatives and spot trading, originating from crypto markets and expanding into new markets.
  
We trade our own capital on systems that run 24/7 and have to be fast and correct without exception. Our systems run on Linux and are written in Rust and Python.

For the Summer of 2027, we're looking for Software Engineer Interns to join our engineering team in Amsterdam.

**The role**

This is an 8-10 week summer internship at our Amsterdam office, giving you a unique opportunity to work on an end-to-end project with a real and direct business impact. You’ll work in a small team and get the chance to understand how a trading firm actually works from the inside.

**You will**

* Participate in a customized training program that will give you an understanding of financial markets in general, the company and the project.
* Own a project from design to deployment guided by experienced software engineers.
* Work with production-level data and systems
* Learn from the best, all while leveraging cutting-edge technology

**What we're looking for**

* Currently in your (pen)ultimate year studying computer science or a related discipline at a top university in Europe
* Available full-time in Amsterdam, for a duration of 8 - 10 weeks over the summer of 2027, starting with 5th of July
* Proficiency in a systems language (ideally Rust and/orC++) and working knowledge of Python
* A solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and what actually makes code fast
* A critical mind that follows things until completion, high ownership, and clear communication in English

**What's in it for you?**

* A summer internship in a relaxed and modern office in Amsterdam
* A dedicated mentor, a team of fellow interns and full-time software engineers, an in-house training program, and exposure to how engineering, research, and trading actually work together
* The opportunity to work at the forefront of automated trading using state-of-the-art technology, in an environment that embraces AI to both accelerate productivity and advance our systems and models
* The opportunity to engage in various sports during working hours, including kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer, plus regular social events including weekly Friday drinks and other celebrations
* Accommodation in Amsterdam for the duration of the program, plus daily breakfast and warm lunch, with snacks and drinks provided throughout the day
* The opportunity to convert into a full-time role after graduation, based on performance

**Our culture**
---------------

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.

In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities.

We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees.

Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.

* Work with varying technologies, such as strictly typed Python (3.14), SQL, Postgres, GCS, mypy, asyncio, aiohttp, pytest, Sentry, Grafana, Redis and many more!

#### **Who are you?**

You are an enthusiastic developer, a critical thinker, and an excellent collaborator. Besides the skills you currently have, an eager-to-learn mindset is just as important. You don’t shy away from taking ownership and responsibility for your projects.

You also have:

* A drive to build with Python, ideally backed by 1+ years of professional experience or several relevant internships.
* Good understanding of HTTP and REST / GraphQL frameworks.
* Familiarity with SQL and relational databases, as we use Postgres heavily.
* Good working knowledge of Linux, Git, and the command-line.

You would stand out from the crowd if you had:

* Experience with concurrent applications, because we do a lot of IO via asyncio!
* Having worked with distributed systems before
* DevOps mentality: at Channable, engineers complete the software development cycle themselves, bring their own code to production, and do so every day.
* Experience with the LGTM stack from Grafana labs (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mirmir) as we use this for monitoring, alerting and visualization

Practical requirements:

* EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands; you are preferably already living in the Netherlands
* Available for at least 32 hours a week, with two days spent at the Utrecht office

**Important note:** we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.

#### **The team:**

Google team focuses on Google marketing integrations, including Google Merchant Center (GMC), Comparison Shopping Services (CSS), and large-scale advertising tools. The team builds and optimizes features to help customers maximize performance.

The Group comprises specialized sub-teams of back-end and front-end, collaborating directly with QA engineers, Product Managers, and UI/UX designers to deliver value to our customers.

If this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

#### **Who are we?**

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

#### **Why Channable?**

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.

#### **More benefits:**

* Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!
* Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport.
* Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM.
* We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!
* Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

jobs.title: Python Developer
jobs.description:
**Highlights**

* Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van back-end services en API's in Python;
* Meedenken over technische verbeteringen en optimalisaties binnen een serverless architectuur op AWS;
* Werken binnen een DevOps-team met een “you build it, you run it”-mentaliteit.

**Omschrijving van je professionele missie**

In deze rol neem jij het voortouw in sprints en epics en maak je deel uit van één van onze multidisciplinaire DevOps-teams. Je ben verantwoordelijk voor het analyseren, bouwen, testen en releasen van software waarbij je niet alleen meedraait, maar ook actief meedenkt over architectuurkeuzes en verbeteringen.

Als Python Developer met een passie voor back-end ontwikkeling binnen moderne cloudomgevingen. Je denkt in schaalbare oplossingen, bouwt efficiënte code en streeft naar maximale automatisering. Je volgt de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen API-ontwikkeling en CI/CD met grote interesse en je vindt het vanzelfsprekend om deze kennis te delen met je collega’s.

**We zoeken jou als je**

* Scrum niet als doel hebt, maar Agile is hoe je werkt en denkt;
* HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau;
* Minimaal drie jaar werkervaring hebt (met Python);
* Bekend bent met IaC-tooling (zoals Terraform, Docker en Kubernetes);
* Kennis hebt van (meerdere) open source libraries en frameworks;
* Weet hoe je frameworks onder de duim houdt en niet andersom;
* Bekend bent met testautomatisering;
* De drang voelt om dingen beter te maken en te groeien;
* Cloud ervaring met je meebrengt; wij werken met AWS.

**Dit heeft Portbase jou te bieden**

* Een aantrekkelijk jaarsalaris, inclusief 13e maand.
* Een vast budget om je thuiswerkplek in te richten en een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.
* 26 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen.
* Een inclusieve werkomgeving met daarbij behorend diversiteitsverlof. Dit gaat om 14 uur per jaar op fulltime basis. Je kunt diversiteitsverlof naar eigen inzicht inzetten voor een feestdag die jij belangrijk vindt.
* Volledige regie over je eigen ontwikkeling met de juiste ondersteuning. Jij bent de regisseur, wij faciliteren.
* Ruimte voor innovatie, eigen initiatief en creatieve ideeën.
* Een inspirerende werkomgeving waarin samenwerking en impact centraal staan.
* Bij Portbase werken wij hybride. Flexibel beslissen waar en wanneer je het meest comfortabel en effectief kunt werken. Dit bepaal je samen met je team en leidinggevende.
* Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling.
* Jaarlijks ontvang je een vitaliteitsbudget a €250,- dit kan je vrij te besteden per jaar ten behoeve van je eigen vitaliteit.

**Over Portbase**

We opereren als IT-bedrijf en als logistiek dienstverlener. We zijn beiden en dat maakt ons sterk. We kennen de markt, de spelers en hun belangen. We brengen partijen samen, initiëren ketenafspraken en werken samen aan oplossingen die de Nederlandse havens en hun supply chains aantrekkelijk maken voor bedrijven die goederen via Europa willen vervoeren.  
  
We luisteren aandachtig naar alle partijen in de logistieke keten. Van rederij tot terminal, van chauffeur tot douanier: alle schakels in de keten hebben hun eigen uitdaging. We werken dan ook voor de gehele havencommunity. Zij werken efficiënter en effectiever door het eenvoudigweg op tijd verwerken van 90 miljoen transacties per jaar via 43 verschillende services

**Keeping things moving**

Portbase bestaat sinds 2002 en daar zijn we trots op. Wat ooit begon met de opdracht om papierwerk te digitaliseren, is uitgegroeid tot een van de meest vooruitstrevende Port Community Systemen van de wereld en een verbindende factor tussen alle havenpartners.  
  
In de toekomst zullen we het voortouw blijven nemen in het ontwikkelen van keten brede digitale oplossingen om integrale dienstverlening eenvoudiger en veiliger te maken. Als er één ding is dat we hebben geleerd in de afgelopen jaren dan is het dat we niet stil kunnen staan. Als havencommunity zijn we in beweging. Letterlijk.

**Sollicitatieprocedure**

Stap 1: Een van onze recruiters neemt contact met je op voor een eerste kennismaking, we beantwoorden ook graag al jouw vragen.

Stap 2: Een 1e interview bij ons op kantoor met je toekomstige manager en een van onze recruiters.

Stap 3: Een online assessment in de vorm van een game die je vanuit huis kan maken in maximaal 30 minuten.

Stap 4: Een 2e interview bij ons op kantoor met een van je belangrijkste stakeholders en een collega uit het team.

Stap 5: Een aanbod.

Stap 6: Je ontvangt je contract en wij starten de pre-employment screening. De screening wordt uitgevoerd door een externe partij.

Wil je meer weten over deze vacature of het werken bij Portbase, neem contact op met een van onze recruiters via werkenbij@portbase.com

Met deze vacature werven wij zelf onze nieuwe collega. Als ons dat niet lukt, nemen wij de stap om een bureau in te schakelen om ons daarbij te helpen. Acquisitie stellen wij daarom niet op prijs. Voor deze vacature staan wij niet open voor een ZZP of tijdelijke invulling.

jobs.title: Junior Data Scientist | Data & Analytics Early Career Program | Utrecht
jobs.description:
**This is what we offer you**
-----------------------------

* **Salary:** Gross monthly salary between EUR 3,516 and EUR 5,021 (scale 07) for a 36-hour work week.
* **Extras:** a thirteenth month, 8% holiday allowance, and a 10% Employee Benefit Budget.
* **Development budget:** EUR 1,400 development budget per year for your growth and development.
* **Hybrid working:** a balance between home and office work (possible for most roles).
* **Pension:** decide for yourself the amount of your personal contribution.

Or view all our benefits.

Would you like to learn and contribute to an existing AI Product that combines data from every angle of the bank, using predictive machine learning models and is currently adapting generative and agentic AI techniques?

**Summary**
-----------

As a Junior Data Scientist at Rabobank, you will learn to build and maintain artificial intelligence solutions in practice. Within the Area Analytics Accelerations you will join the CLUE (Client Lifecycle Understanding Engine) team and contribute to building and improving models and analytical solutions to improve our client interaction, like client clustering models and propensity models for product suggestion. You will primarily be using traditional machine learning techniques complemented with generative and agentic AI. The team is responsible for the end-to-end product, from design to actual production environment.

You have a combined interest in Data Science, MLOps and Integration engineering, where Integration engineering is the discipline of connecting applications, platforms and data sources.

You will work with Python, Databricks, traditional machine learning, generative and agentic AI to create scalable and reliable solutions for complex banking challenges.

The role is part of the Advanced Analytics Early Career Program.

**What will you learn and do as a Junior data scientist?**
----------------------------------------------------------

* How to develop, maintain and improve analytics solutions (e.g.: data engineering, ML Engineering, Model Estimation/Evaluation, Prompt Engineering).
* Combine statistical knowledge, data insights with technical infrastructure needed to build reliable and innovative AI solutions.
* Learn how to translate a business request into a data science solution.
* Work with experienced colleagues to turn analytical ideas into practical applications.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and technical development within the Advanced Analytics community.

**Together we achieve more than alone**
---------------------------------------

We believe in the power of differences. By combining people's differences, we become an even better bank. We are curious about what you will bring to our Area Analytics Accelerations.

You will join a collaborative team that includes several current and former Early Career Program participants. You will work with colleagues who enjoy exploring technical subjects, sharing knowledge and helping each other develop. You do not need to be the loudest person in the room, but you should be willing to explain your ideas and work constructively with others.

**Your development in the Early Career Program**
------------------------------------------------

In the Rabobank Early Career Program, you will work on your personal development and the technical content of your role for 18 months.

You will begin in a junior role within one team and learn mainly through practical experience. You will take part in workshops and training modules with other young professionals. Experienced colleagues will support your technical development, and a buddy will help you find your way within Rabobank.

You will also receive guidance on your personal development and build a network within the Advanced Analytics community. There is room to contribute ideas for events, training and knowledge-sharing sessions.

**Why everyone is welcome at Rabobank**
---------------------------------------

At Rabobank, we are working towards a culture where everyone feels welcome. We value our differences and use them to collaborate more effectively and make better decisions. By being open to different perspectives, we create an environment where colleagues feel heard.

**What do you bring?**
----------------------

Must-haves:

* You have completed, or will soon complete, a master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Mathematics or a comparable technical studies.
* Your studies, thesis, internship, project or personal work demonstrate knowledge of traditional machine learning/statistics and the implementation of AI models.
* You have 0-2 years of working experience after graduating.
* You have experience with Python.
* You are interested in both traditional machine learning and generative artificial intelligence, including Agentic AI.
* You want to understand the technical infrastructure behind artificial intelligence solutions, rather than working only with models.
* You can communicate technical ideas clearly and work effectively with colleagues.
* You have an excellent command of English.
* You currently live in the Netherlands.

Nice-to-haves:

* You have worked with Databricks.
* You have experience building a technical project outside your formal study programme.
* You are familiar with cloud technology, Git or continuous integration and delivery.

**You and the application process**
-----------------------------------

Apply by a date that is not yet established.

* Questions about the recruitment procedure? Contact Clemens Schinkel, Young Talent Recruiter at Clemens.Schinkel@Rabobank.nl.
* The selection process is expected to include 2 interview rounds both online and in our office in Utrecht.
* If you are invited for an interview, Bo, our virtual assistant, will contact you by SMS and email to schedule the interview.
* A reliability assessment is part of the procedure.
* An assessment can be part of the application process.
