jobs.title: Marketing Data Scientist – CHO Herengracht Amsterdam | 40h
jobs.description:
Shape the future of e-commerce and digital marketing by joining our digital team! Bring your digital (marketing) expertise and entrepreneurial spirit to the table, and let's create exceptional omni-channel experiences together.

**Share your talents**
----------------------

Are you passionate about untangling complex marketing data to discover what truly drives growth? Do you thrive at the intersection of advanced data science and strategic marketing consulting? Then this could be your next adventure.

At Rituals, we’re looking for a Senior Marketing Data Scientist to take ownership of our marketing measurement initiatives. You will be a driving force behind our measurement triangle, bringing together Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), and Incrementality Testing.

In this role, you will turn complex data into clear direction for our marketing teams, helping shape smarter budget decisions and stronger campaign performance. You will not only build and improve models but also act as a trusted advisor who translates technical outcomes into practical recommendations. Working closely with digital, marketing, and data colleagues, you will help us strengthen our measurement capabilities and create a more connected view of impact across channels. It is a role with visible business impact, where curiosity, ownership, and thoughtful challenge are just as important as technical depth.

**Share your Talent**

* You will drive our Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) initiatives. Using Bayesian modeling, you will measure and quantify both the short-term direct revenue and the long-term brand-building impact of our marketing investments.
* You will be responsible for the end-to-end development and optimization of our Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) framework. Utilizing GA4 data and advanced algorithmic models, you will map out complex customer journeys to help teams steer on granular, day-to-day media tactics.
* You will design and execute our Test & Learn roadmap with different digital marketing teams. By running controlled experiments you will measure true causal impact. You will prove which sales were actually driven by our campaigns, validating our models and ensuring we optimize our budgets with confidence.
* You will build a Unified Measurement View. You will bridge the gap between MMM, MTA, and testing - calibrating the models against each other to create a single source of truth and clear guidance for the business.
* You will translate models into media action. By actively running media scenario planners and delivering insights*,* you will help the marketing teams to build highly optimized and profitable media plans.
* You will drive measurement adoption. You will operationalize data science outputs by structuring our measurement calendar, defining core reporting templates, and advising marketing teams on KPIs to make data-driven decision-making the standard.

**Your team**

You will be part of our broader Digital team, sitting within the Digital & Customer Data Insights department. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager Data Science & Marketing Measurement, you will work closely with marketing managers, digital specialists and data colleagues.

**Why you’ll love this role**

* You’ll shape a core marketing measurement capability in a company that’s scaling globally with purpose.
* You’ll get the best of both worlds: deep, technical data science work combined with high-level strategic consulting and stakeholder management.
* You’ll have a visible business impact, where your models and insights directly fuel smarter media investments.
* You’ll work alongside smart, passionate colleagues across digital, marketing, and the wider data science team.

**Bring all of you**
--------------------

**Your qualifications:**

* A degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Mathematics, or Engineering.
* 3+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, or a related quantitative role, specifically within a marketing, media or commercial context.
* A strong technical foundation in programming (e.g. Python and SQL) and familiarity with cloud environments and data visualization tools.
* Experience with, or a strong understanding of, marketing measurement techniques (such as MMM, Attribution or Incrementality Testing) and digital marketing data (e.g. GA4).
* The ability to translate complex data science concepts into clear, actionable recommendations for media managers and senior leadership.
* Proven experience independently driving complex analytics or data science projects from problem definition through stakeholder adoption.

**On top of this:**

* You combine strong technical expertise with a grounded and thoughtful consulting mindset.
* You understand that the value of data science is not only in building models, but in helping people make better decisions with confidence.
* You feel comfortable working in a complex measurement landscape and know how to bring structure and clarity when not every answer is certain.
* You are curious, proactive, and motivated by meaningful impact.

At Rituals, we are committed to care for everyone and strive to create a diverse workplace where all employees belong and have equal opportunities to succeed. Read more about our commitment here: **Diversity and Inclusion**. We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and teamwork. Therefore, we work predominantly from the office.

**Grow with us! The next steps are:**

* Apply via our website (make sure you meet the requirements and tell us why you apply).

* In the event of a positive outcome, you will receive a proposal with the terms of employment.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Amsterdam

Engineering – Product Engineering /

International Full Time Employee /

On-site

**Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant.**

As a Junior Data Scientist at Samba in Amsterdam, you will own end-to-end delivery of significant data science projects with minimal guidance. You are a reliable, autonomous contributor with deep expertise in at least one of Samba's core domains — Identity and audience modelling and the technical range to build production-ready solutions using modern ML and AI methodologies. You'll work closely with peers, product, and engineering.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Own end-to-end delivery of significant data science projects from problem scoping and approach design through to production deployment
* Make sound, independently-reasoned decisions on methodology, model selection, and evaluation; document them clearly in technical solution documents covering problem statement, approach, metrics, and timeline
* Lead solution design for your own initiatives; break down complex epics into well-scoped user stories with clear acceptance criteria, adopting DataOps and MLOps best practices throughout — experiment tracking, pipeline orchestration, model monitoring, and reproducibility
* Implement advanced ML and AI-powered workflows including entity resolution, probabilistic record linkage, embedding-based matching, semantic similarity, and LLM-augmented pipelines
* Develop and maintain reusable tools, libraries, and documentation that improve team efficiency and technical standards; conduct code reviews with constructive, specific feedback that raises the bar
* Be a team player and collaborate with different teams.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and operations — translate business requirements into technical specifications, partner with data engineering on scalable pipeline design, and participate in cross-functional design reviews and working groups

### **Who You Are:**

* **Bachelor's degree** required in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics or a related quantitative field; Master's strongly preferred
* 2+ years of hands-on data science experience with demonstrated ability to own and deliver complex, multi-sprint projects independently
* Advanced **Python** (**or any other programming language+Claude/Codex/any other**) with production-quality code, testing, and documentation; strong SQL and PySpark for billion-row datasets
* Databricks (nice to have/learn for 2027) workflows, Delta Lake, and job orchestration; working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS or GCP)
* **Solid command of core ML** — regression, classification, clustering, model evaluation, and experimental design — applied to complex, high-volume data (2 questions to level)
* Proficiency with MLOps practices: experiment tracking and reproducible model deployment
* **Exposure to modern AI methodologies**: RAG systems, LLM-augmented models, vector databases, and semantic search (showcase+examples)
* **Strong communicator** — able to translate technical work into clear documentation, user stories, and cross-functional conversations
* Demonstrated ability to mentor junior data scientists and contribute to team standards
* **Team player**

**Samba is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We strive to empower connection with one another, reflect the communities we serve, and tackle meaningful projects that make a real impact.**

Samba may collect personal information directly from you, as a job applicant, Samba may also receive personal information from third parties, for example, in connection with a background, employment or reference check, in accordance with the applicable law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Together with the team, you will be responsible for building and optimizing robust data pipelines and further scaling the measurement datasets to turn them into actionable insights - including pipelines that serve as the foundation for machine learning and AI use cases.

------------------

Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar de verhalen achter data? Vind je het leuk om analyses te maken die leiden tot betere beslissingen? En wil je jouw kennis inzetten voor een organisatie met maatschappelijke impact? Dan zoeken wij jou als stagiair Data Analist binnen Team Sourcing van DJI.
  
  
Binnen Team Sourcing van de afdeling Werving & Selectie zoeken wij vanaf februari een enthousiaste stagiair die ons helpt om recruitment nog meer datagedreven te maken. Je werkt mee aan het verzamelen, analyseren en vertalen van data naar concrete inzichten waarmee we onze wervingsactiviteiten kunnen verbeteren.
  
  
Team Sourcing is een snelgroeiend team binnen DJI en bestaat uit 18 enthousiaste collega’s. Wij richten ons op de instroom van nieuwe collega’s voor executieve functies, zoals complexbeveiligers, penitentiair inrichtingswerkers (PIW), forensisch therapeutisch medewerkers en arbeidsbegeleiders.
  
  
Naast persoonlijke begeleiding van kandidaten houden wij ons bezig met online sourcing, campagnes, evenementen en het versterken van onze recruitmentfunnel. Data speelt hierin een steeds grotere rol: welke activiteiten leveren resultaat op? Waar liggen kansen om processen te verbeteren? En hoe kunnen we onze keuzes beter onderbouwen?
  
  
Als data-stagiair bouw je voort op bestaande inzichten en help je Team Sourcing verder ontwikkelen op het gebied van data en analyse.
  
  
Je werkt minimaal drie dagen per week mee binnen ons team (waarvan twee dagen op locatie en één dag in overleg). De overige tijd gebruik je voor je eigen (afstudeer)onderzoek of opdracht.
  
  
Je houdt je bijvoorbeeld bezig met:

* Het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van data-rapportages en dashboards voor Team Sourcing;
* Ondersteunen bij het verwerken van leads uit events en campagnes;
* Het verzamelen en analyseren van data uit systemen en platforms zoals LinkedIn en Indeed;
* Landelijke trends analyseren en op basis daarvan aanbevelingen doen;
* Het analyseren van resultaten van evenementen, campagnes en selectiedagen;
* Het presenteren van inzichten en aanbevelingen tijdens teamoverleggen.
  

Heb je zelf een interessant onderzoek idee rondom data, AI, recruitment of procesverbetering? We denken graag met je mee om hier samen een passende opdracht van te maken.

Kijk jij voorbij aan wat iemand gedaan heeft?

**Waar kan je op rekenen als je stage loopt bij DJI**
-----------------------------------------------------

Bij DJI krijg je als stagiair de ruimte om te leren, ervaring op te doen en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Of je nu mbo-, hbo- of wo-student bent: we zorgen voor goede begeleiding, duidelijke afspraken en een eerlijke vergoeding.

### **Stagevergoeding**

Loop je bij DJI een stage van één maand of langer? Dan ontvang je een stagevergoeding.

Vanaf 1 januari 2026 is dit € 800,- per maand bij een stage van 40 uur per week.

Loop je minder uren stage? Dan passen we de vergoeding aan.

Voor snuffelstages of stages korter dan één maand is een vergoeding niet verplicht.

### **Reiskosten**

Kun je geen gebruikmaken van een OV-studentenkaart? Dan kun je een reiskostenvergoeding krijgen voor je reis naar de stageplek.

Maak je een dienstreis voor je stage? Dan worden deze kosten vergoed volgens de regels van de Rijksoverheid.

### **Begeleiding**

Je krijgt bij DJI altijd een stagebegeleider. Deze helpt je op weg, beantwoordt je vragen en begeleidt je tijdens je stage.

Loop je ergens tegenaan of heb je vragen? Dan kun je altijd terecht bij je begeleider of de stagecoördinator.

### **Vakantie en vrije dagen**

Loop je een stage van één maand of langer? Dan bouw je vakantie-uren op.

Hoeveel uren dit zijn, hangt af van je stageperiode en het aantal uren per week.

### **Afspraken en veiligheid**

Tijdens je stage houd je je aan de huisregels van DJI. Vertrouwelijkheid en zorgvuldigheid zijn belangrijk.

Om stage te lopen bij de Rijksoverheid, moet je een stageovereenkomst en geheimhoudingsverklaring ondertekenen en een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) overhandigen. Je stageafspraken staan altijd vastgelegd in een stageovereenkomst.

### **Na je stage**

Een stage bij DJI is geen garantie voor een baan. Wel doe je waardevolle ervaring op in een organisatie met grote maatschappelijke impact.

Na je stage kun je reageren op vacatures of traineeprogramma's bij DJI en andere organisaties binnen de Rijksoverheid.

**Dit neem je mee**
-------------------

Een resultaatgericht team vind je uitdagend en leer je graag van. Je helpt niet alleen mee, maar denkt ook actief mee over hoe we ons werk effectiever kunnen aanpakken. Je (afstudeer)opdracht of onderzoek stemmen we samen af, zodat jij veel leert en wij iets hebben aan jouw inzichten.

* Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding met een focus op data, IT, business analytics of vergelijkbaar;
* Je kunt vanaf februari van start gaan;
* Je bent handig met Excel en PowerPoint en hebt een analytische mindset;
* Je hebt affiniteit met AI, data en IT;
* Je houdt van structuur, details en werken met cijfers;
* Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en durft initiatief te tonen.

**Bijzonderheden**
------------------

* Om stage te lopen bij de Rijksoverheid, moet je een stageovereenkomst en geheimhoudingsverklaring ondertekenen en een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) overhandigen;

jobs.title: Group Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Full-time · Amsterdam Head Office

**About the company:** With more than 700 employees at eight terminals in seven key strategic hubs in Europe, we offer tailored storage solutions for liquid energy and chemicals. Every day, we look for better solutions, better service and better performance. We embrace the exciting opportunities ahead of us by combining our strengths, expertise and capabilities with those of our partners. Helping to deliver cleaner energy to empower society.

**About the IT & OT Team:** The Evos IT/OT team is responsible for ensuring secure, stable, and efficient IT and OT operations across all terminals. The department consists of several specialized teams covering IT Security, Business Applications, End User Services, IT Infrastructure, and Operational Technology. These teams work closely together with experienced colleagues and service partners. Data security and governance are embedded in both daily operations and continuous improvement initiatives.

**About the role:** Evos is looking for a Data Analyst enjoys turning data from our terminal operations into meaningful insights, reporting, and operational improvements. Experience with analytics and forecasting is an advantage.

This is a versatile role where you will work with data from across our terminals, build and maintain reporting solutions, perform analyses, and share insights with operational, supply chain, and commercial stakeholders. You will learn and grow with the support of an experienced data team.

Reporting to the Group BI & Data Manager, you will work in a modern Microsoft data platform environment: Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, SQL, and Python/PySpark.

**Key responsibilities**

* Build and maintain analytics-ready data models and transformations in Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse/Warehouse, SQL, PySpark), using version control and CI/CD
* Build semantic models and Power BI reports (including Direct Lake) that give operational and commercial teams reliable, self-service insights
* Perform data analyses to explain trends, deviations, root causes, and business performance
* Support forecasting activities and help identify trends in throughput, tank utilisation, vessel/truck/rail movements, and demand
* Help identify and quantify operational improvement opportunities, such as turnaround times, capacity utilisation, planning efficiency, and energy consumption
* Translate business questions into analyses and present clear, actionable insights to stakeholders
* Contribute to data quality, documentation, and consistent KPI definitions across terminals, in line with data governance and security standards
* Explore opportunities to apply advanced analytics, AI, and machine learning where they can add business value

**Work location**

This role is based in the Netherlands.

**About you: Experience & knowledge**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field
* 2–6 years of experience in a data, analytics, or data science role
* Good SQL and Python skills (e.g. pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels)
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric or comparable platforms (Azure Synapse, Databricks)
* Experience with Power BI, including dimensional modelling (star schema), DAX, and semantic models
* A good foundation in statistics and time series forecasting, and experience applying it to real business data
* An understanding of data governance and data quality
* Fluent English, our main working language

**Nice to have**

* Experience with PySpark
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub and CI/CD
* Domain or functional knowledge of logistics and supply chain
* Dutch, German, Spanish, French, or Maltese
* Exposure to machine learning tools or AI applications is a plus

Don’t tick every box? We still encourage you to apply.

**Competencies**

* Curious, analytical mind with a critical eye for data and assumptions
* Business-oriented: able to turn complex analysis into actionable stories with measurable impact
* Versatile and pragmatic, eager to learn and to take ownership of your work
* Strong communicator and collaborative team player across IT, OT, and business teams

**Our offer:** We offer a role in a dynamic and professional environment where your analyses help shape how our terminals operate, with plenty of room to grow your skills in data science, analytics engineering, and modern data platforms.

In addition, we offer:

* A competitive salary based on your knowledge and experience
* Travel allowance
* A solid pension plan
* A supportive and collaborative team environment
* Hybrid working, with 2–3 days per week from home
* Opportunities for personal development and growth

Salary

Attractive compensation & benefits package

Holiday Leave

30 vacation days per year

Personal Growth

You will have a lot of possibilities

jobs.title: Data analyst
jobs.description:
#### **About the position**

At EQOM, you will work with data in a way that truly adds value to the business. You will be the point of contact for the teams and help them make better decisions based on data. Whether it's building dashboards, performing analyses, or intelligently modeling data at scale, you will ensure that insights are directly applicable to your colleagues' daily work. AI plays a key role in this. We use AI to make our own work easier and more efficient, and we also make sure our users can use AI to make better decisions, always with quality safeguarded.  
  
Structuring, automating processes, and communicating clearly are second nature to you. You coach colleagues and work closely with teams such as e-commerce, marketing, logistics, finance, sales, and purchasing—both B2B and B2C.  
  
Examples of projects you will work on:

* Funnel analyses based on event data
* Product recommendations for specific customers
* Reducing customer queries through data-driven insights
* Inventory- and assortment optimization
* Forecasting

Our modern data stack:  

* Databricks on Azure
* dbt for data modeling
* Snowplow
* Power BI (or other BI/visualization tools)

You will be part of our international Data team, consisting of data & web analysts, analytics engineers, and data engineers.

#### **About us**

EQOM is a fast-growing international player in the intimate wellness sector. From our head office in Veendam, we work with over 400 colleagues in Europe on our mission: to make sexual wellbeing and pleasure accessible to everyone - regardless of preference, age or physical condition. We manage strong brands such as EasyToys, Amorelie and Adam & Eve and offer more than 14,000 products through our webshops and wholesale.  
  
What makes EQOM unique? A vibrant culture of entrepreneurship, creativity and collaboration. We are driven to break taboos and bring about change in a category that is still often uncomfortable.  
  
At EQOM, you will have the opportunity to make an impact in a sector that matters.

#### **About you**

You sense what the business needs and know how to ask questions to get to the heart of the matter. You translate complex data into simple, practical insights that deliver immediate value. You also communicate insights clearly to colleagues without a technical background, in a way that suits their role and field of expertise. In this way, you ensure that your dashboard, report, or data product is of great value to the internal user and thus to our success as a company.  
  
You have a commercial mindset and understand how marketing, e-commerce, or logistics work. The solutions you create are reusable and fit the needs of the business, whether it's a report, analysis, or data model. You know how to build a comprehensive SQL query and understand it from start to finish.  
  
You are a pleasant person to talk to: open, honest, and always focused on the common goal. Your communication style is clear and adaptive, taking into account different styles or cultural backgrounds.

#### **Do you bring the following to our company?**

What are we looking for? What can you bring to EQOM?

* Higher vocational education (HBO) level of working and thinking
* At least 4 years of experience as a data analyst
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
* Experience in a commercial environment with speed and focus on results
* You make AI tools a standard part of your workflow to improve and simplify your work
* Strong knowledge of and experience with SQL
* You are familiar with building/structuring/transforming data
* Experience with PowerBI (or similar) for building dashboards
* Experience with Python, dbt, and/or Databricks is an advantage
* Able to patiently convert a vague question into concrete products

  
**Good to know:**  
Our Data Team is spread across our offices in Veendam, Berlin and Hilversum. We ask you to travel to Veendam once a month.

#### **What does this job offer you?**

If you come to work at EQOM, you can count on a unique opportunity within an ambitious company. We offer you:

* A one-year contract for 32, 36, or 40 hours per week—in consultation, of course
* A competitive salary
* Flexible working hours and hybrid working (home & office) if desired
* Travel allowance
* Home working allowance
* 25 vacation days based on a 40-hour working week
* 8% vacation pay
* The option to purchase additional vacation days
* Pension accrual with the Retail Pension Fund
* A large joint company lunch on Fridays
* The option to work on-premise for 6 weeks, for example in combination with a trip
* Free in-house gym + discount on your gym membership via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland
* Our activities committee organizes various fun activities and a few larger events such as a Summer BBQ and Oktoberfest.
* Plenty of room for personal development and growth!

  
Would you like to work on exciting projects in an international company? Now is the time to join EQOM. We look forward to getting to know you!

#### **Are you ready?**

Interested? Apply now. We look forward to getting to know you!  
Want more information first? Contact Corporate Recruitment at careers@eqom.com.

jobs.title: Data Analist
jobs.description:
Ben jij een Data Analist die graag data omzet in inzichten die er écht toe doen? Bij BeFrank krijg je de kans om als dé Data Analist binnen de keten Werkgever & Adviseur aan de slag te gaan. Daarbij werk je samen met Data Analist uit onze andere ketens, zoals de keten Deelnemer en de keten Finance & Beleggen. Heb je affiniteit met Power BI, SQL en datagedreven besluitvorming? Dan ontmoeten we je graag!

*Please note: since BeFrank is a Dutch pension company, all our internal and external communication is in Dutch. It is therefore a strict requirement for applicants to speak and write fluent Dutch in order to qualify for a position at BeFrank.*

**Jouw impact als Data Scientist**
----------------------------------

Als Data Analist binnen de keten Werkgever & Adviseur verantwoordelijk voor de informatievoorziening binnen deze keten. Jij voorziet de business in de informatiebehoefte doormiddel van het opstellen van trendanalyses, rapportages en bouwen van dashboards. Het realiseren en ouderhouden van rapportages (periodiek & ad hoc) en dashboards). En analyse en advies over kwaliteit van data (datamanagement). Dankzij jouw analyses weet je het MT te prikkelen met nieuwe resultaten en inzichten op basis waarvan de bedrijfsvoering in de brede zin verbetert. Dat betekent dat je op een breed pallet van de bedrijfsvoering bijdraagt, van Finance naar HR naar operatie en kwaliteit.

In samenwerking met de Data Steward draag je bij aan het verbeteren van de datakwaliteit binnen BeFrank. Je bent ook verantwoordelijk voor het analyseren van data en deze te vertalen naar bedrijfs-en strategisch advies binnen deze keten. Ook zorg je voor de uitvoering en follow-up van dataprojecten. Daarnaast adviseur jij het MT op basis van de gevonden inzichten en lever je een bijdrage aan de visievorming.

**Met wie je werkt**
--------------------

Binnen de keten Werkgever & Adviseur val je onder het Business & Change team. Dit team bestaat verder uit Business Analisten, Productmanagers, Communicatiespecialist en een UX designer. Daarnaast zal je ook samenwerken met de Data Analisten uit de 2 andere ketens binnen BeFrank en met de Developers en de Product Owner van de keten.

**Wat je gaat doen**
--------------------

* Uitvoeren van (complexe) data- analyses en vertalen van data en analyses naar bedrijfs- en strategisch advies en zorgen voor de uitvoering en follow-up van dataprojecten.
* Meedenken over verbeteringen van de datakwaliteit binnen BeFrank (samen met de Data Steward).
* Op basis van de informatiebehoefte van de teams ontwikkelen van nieuwe rapportages, zoals financiële rapportages, proces- en stuurinformatie of klantinzichten, op basis van de beschikbare data.
* Onderzoekt pro-actief patronen in data door middel van complexe statistische analyses en modellen en ontwikkelt op basis daarvan inzichten en adviseert pro-actief het MT van de keten.
* Eigenaar business intelligence: draagt zorg voor visualisatie van data en bepaalt hoe datavisualisatie het best kan worden toegepast, van het opstellen van requirements tot het genereren van inzichten (in informatie, KPI’s en knelpunten). Ontwikkelt samen met de business klantmodellen en voorspelmodellen en past deze toe.
* Adviseren van het MT van de keten op basis van gevonden inzichten en levert bijdrage aan visievorming.
* Onderhoudt de contacten met de verschillende teams om de informatiebehoefte te achterhalen.

**Wat je meebrengt**
--------------------

Je hebt HBO/WO denkniveau met 2-3 jaar relevante werkervaring als Data Analist. Je hebt een Beta studie afgerond zoals Econometrie, Technische bedrijfskunde, Natuurkunde, Wiskunde of andere relevante studies. Je hebt kennis van onder andere Power BI, Python, R en SQL. Ook weet je goed hoe om te gaan met statistiek en data analyse. Daarnaast ben je klantgericht.

**Arbeidsvoorwaarden die bij jou passen**
-----------------------------------------

Behalve uitdagend werk binnen een omgeving waar jouw initiatief op prijs wordt gesteld, bieden wij jou een uitstekend arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket, dat bestaat uit:

* Passend salaris o.b.v. 40 uur (Salarisschaal €4.665 – €6.665 afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring)
* Vaste eindejaarsuitkering
* Prestatiebonus
* Internetvergoeding
* NS Business Card, waarmee je ook privé vrij kan reizen, kilometervergoeding of een (elektrische) Swapfiets
* 29 vakantiedagen + 1 persoonlijke feestdag
* Modern premievrij pensioen
* Goede opleidingsmogelijkheden
* Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid
* Hybride werken vanuit ons duurzaam verbouwde kantoor in Amsterdam! (Bij BeFrank werken we allemaal minstens 50% op kantoor, maar 100% op kantoor mag natuurlijk ook.)

**Over BeFrank**
----------------

Wij zijn een moderne, online pensioenuitvoerder en bieden bedrijven een collectieve pensioenoplossing. Onze missie is om pensioen weer dichter bij de mens te brengen. Dat doen we door begrijpelijk te communiceren en alles eenvoudig te houden. En door zowel werkgevers als werknemers 24/7 inzicht te geven in hun pensioen via een slimme en duidelijke online omgeving.

**Wij zijn B Corp!** Sinds 2024 zijn we officieel een B Corp. Dat betekent dat we ondernemen met oog voor mens, maatschappij en milieu. We beleggen duurzaam, we doen vrijwilligerswerk en reizen zo bewust mogelijk. Ook ons kantoor is gebouwd met de toekomst in gedachten en is voor 80% circulair. Want pensioen gaat niet alleen over geld. Het gaat ook over de wereld waarin je straks leeft.

**Onze cultuur.** Onze cultuur kenmerkt zich door lef, innovatie en klantgericht denken. Omdat we een zelfstandig label zijn hebben we korte lijnen. We werken elke dag hard om het beste product te maken, met de beste service. En successen vieren we samen!

**Iedereen hoort erbij bij BeFrank!** Wij geloven in de kracht van een inclusieve werkomgeving, waarin je 100% jezelf kunt zijn. Daarom vinden we het belangrijk dat iedereen met een drive om de pensioenwereld te vernieuwen zich welkom voelt om bij ons te solliciteren.

In deze rol ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het visualiseren van data met behulp van ons datawarehouse (Snowflake) en BI-platform (Power BI). Daarnaast voer je analyses uit die inzichten opleveren voor de verbetering van onze logistieke operatie. De standplaats is Waalwijk. Hybride werken en flexibele uren zijn zeker bespreekbaar, maar voor een gezonde samenwerking met collega’s gaan we uit van ongeveer drie dagen per week op locatie.

jobs.title: Data Analist - Client Integrity (ICS)
jobs.description:
Data Analist - Client Integrity (ICS)

**In het kort**
---------------

International Card Services (ICS) is een betalingsdienstverlener en marktleider op het gebied van het uitgeven van creditcards in Nederland. We zijn een 100% dochteronderneming van ABN AMRO Bank N.V. Een stabiel en betrouwbaar systeem is voor onze klanten essentieel. Om onze positie verder te versterken en bij te dragen aan onze missie, zijn we op zoek naar een Data Analist die helpt bij het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van rapportages en dashboards die inzicht bieden in Client Integrity en bijdragen aan datagedreven besluitvorming.

**Je werk**
-----------

* Je ontwikkelt rapportages en dashboards, analyseert data en gaat samen met stakeholders op zoek naar antwoorden op uiteenlopende vraagstukken.
* Vertalen van complexe data-inzichten naar concrete, begrijpelijke adviezen voor management en stakeholders. Je rapporteert bijvoorbeeld over trends en geeft aanbevelingen voor optimalisering van operationele regels op basis van jouw analyses.
* Je verdiept je in processen, stelt kritische vragen en probeert te begrijpen wat er achter de cijfers schuil gaat.
* Daarnaast denk je mee over hoe rapportages, datasets en teamprocessen slimmer en efficiënter kunnen worden ingericht. We zoeken iemand die niet alleen uitvoert, maar ook kansen ziet en initiatief neemt om verbeteringen aan te dragen.

**Werkomgeving**
----------------

Je komt te werken in het Data Office, waar we data omzetten in inzichten die helpen om betere beslissingen te nemen en de organisatie verder te ontwikkelen. Vijf teams werken hier dagelijks aan één missie: data inzetten als strategisch vermogen. Je zal komen te werken in het Client Integrity Reporting team. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor alle MI (Management Informatie) met betrekking tot Client Integrity, waaronder KYC, SIRA, SIM en Transactie Monitoring. We bouwen rapportages, beantwoorden complexe vragen vanuit de business en helpen collega's om data beter te begrijpen en te gebruiken.

Jij brengt structuur in de chaos. Je vertaalt vragen en ideeën vanuit de business naar heldere analyses en bruikbare inzichten. Samen met je collega's ontwikkel en verbeter je rapportages, dashboards en datasets die stakeholders helpen bij hun dagelijkse werkzaamheden en besluitvorming. Je onderzoekt trends, verdiept je in processen en stelt kritische vragen om de vraag achter de vraag te begrijpen. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar wat de data laat zien, maar denk je ook mee over mogelijke verbeteringen en vervolgstappen.

**Je profiel**
--------------

* Een afgeronde bachelor- of masteropleiding in een relevant werkgebied. Of een gelijkwaardig denk- en oplossend niveau in een kwantitatief georiënteerd vakgebied.
* Je hebt 3 jaar ervaring met SQL en Power BI (inclusief DAX) en het vertalen van data naar inzichten en rapportages voor stakeholders.
* Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en niet bang om de status quo uit te dagen. Je verbindt mensen en data, stelt scherpe vragen en neemt initiatief om verbeteringen te realiseren.
* Je toont eigenaarschap door verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor eigen acties en beslissingen en zet zich in voor het behalen van (afdeling)doelen of het oplossen van problemen.
* Ervaring binnen het Client Integrity, AML- of WWFT-domein is een pré, maar geen harde eis. We vinden het belangrijker dat je analytisch sterk bent, graag leert en energie krijgt van het oplossen van vraagstukken.

Je duikt in data, goederenstromen en resultaten en vertaalt complexe informatie naar heldere inzichten en concrete acties. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines en bent een belangrijke sparringpartner voor de business. Je werkt zowel voor de commerciele divisie als ook voor operations.

Een dynamische rol voor een analytische professional die energie krijgt van de business, graag verbinding zoekt en met data zichtbaar verschil wil maken. Je standplaats is onze locatie Seinehaven in de Botlek.

**Hier ga je mee aan de slag**

**Wat je van ons mag verwachten**

jobs.title: HR Data Analyst
jobs.description:
This Is What Your Role Looks Like

As HR Data Analyst at Basic-Fit, you make sure HR data across countries becomes consistent, trustworthy, and ready for reporting and analysis. You'll get to the core of our data, uncover inconsistencies, and turn them into concrete improvement proposals. You will shape the foundation for HR analytics in our Workday environment. You’ll work closely with the HR Business Process Owner to understand how HR data is used and where it breaks down.

If you get genuine satisfaction from getting data right at the root - and like the idea of building something from the ground up - this role is for you.

Your Responsibilities

* Collaborate closely with the HR Business Process Owner to align data definitions with how HR actually works in each country
* Identify inconsistencies: Analyze data for quality issues, gaps, and differences between countries — for example, why contract-type data is registered differently between the Netherlands and France
* Get to the core: Investigate root causes of data inconsistency, not just the symptoms
* Propose improvements: Translate findings into concrete, actionable improvement proposals
* Uniform standards: Contribute to defining and embedding data standards across our organization
* Build and support a set of standard HR reports
* Build dashboards in Power BI to visualize HR data
* Develop analyses that support HR and business decision-making.

Who Are You?

You're analytically sharp and genuinely curious about what's behind the numbers. You don't settle for a quick fix — you want to understand why data doesn't add up before proposing a solution. You're comfortable working with data from multiple countries, enjoy building structure where there is none yet, and communicate findings clearly to both HR and technical colleagues.

What you bring:

* Experience in data analysis, ideally within HR or a comparable domain
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
* Affinity with HR systems; experience with Workday is a plus
* Experience with Power BI or willingness to grow into this
* Experience in an international, multi-country environment is a plus
* Fluent English; Dutch, French, Spanish, or German is a plus

Your Environment

* You will be part of the HR team and work closely with stakeholders in our HR Improvement Team and with the Workday technical team.
* Close collaboration with the HR Business Process Owner and HR stakeholders across countries
* Underlying system: Workday, across NL, BE, FR, ES, DE and AT
* No established HR data platform or BI stack yet — you help us shape the foundation

What We Offer You

At Basic-Fit, it’s not just about work, it’s about your growth. As a HR Data Analyst, you’ll have the freedom to make an impact and develop yourself in a dynamic environment.

What you can expect from us:

* Learning & Development: Unlimited access to GoodHabitz and LinkedIn Learning.
* Career Growth: Plenty of opportunities for professional and personal development.
* Work Culture: An informal, international, and down-to-earth environment. We value working together, so we work 4 days in the office, 1 day from home.
* Innovation: Your ideas contribute to strategic projects.
* Salary: A monthly gross salary between €3500 and €4500 based on 40 hours, depending on your experience and background.
* Perks & Benefits: Travel allowance, bike plan, health insurance discounts, remote work allowance, and a pension plan (52% contribution by Basic-Fit).
* Fitness: Access to our gym at HQ.

About Basic-Fit

Basic-Fit is Europe's leader in the value-for-money fitness market, with more than 4.7 million members across 1,650+ clubs in 6 countries. We are continuously growing and improving. If you're looking for a place where you can make an impact while having fun at work, you've come to the right place!

What Makes Us Unique?

* Work with Impact: What you do makes a difference. We don’t just work for our members, partners, and teams—we work with them.
* Collaboration: Everyone works together to achieve goals and celebrate success.
* Diversity & Inclusion: We welcome everyone into our workplace.

Apply Now!  
Ready for your next adventure? Click the Apply button, and we’ll get in touch with you as soon as possible.

Questions? Feel free to contact Kerensa van der Lans at kerensa.vanderlans@basic-fit.com.

jobs.title: Medior Data / AI Engineer

-------------

### **Bij CZ werken we met betekenis, daadkracht en als één team.**

We nemen verantwoordelijkheid, tonen lef, blijven leren en maken impact. Samen zetten we ons elke dag in voor toegankelijke en betaalbare zorg voor iedereen. Data en AI spelen een steeds belangrijkere rol binnen CZ. We ontwikkelen slimme oplossingen die onze klanten, medewerkers en zorgpartners helpen betere beslissingen te nemen en efficiënter te werken. Van generatieve AI en intelligente agents tot geavanceerde data-oplossingen en automatisering: de mogelijkheden zijn enorm. Wil jij je ontwikkelen tot Data/AI Engineer en meebouwen aan innovatieve oplossingen die écht impact maken? Dan krijg je bij CZ de kans om ervaring op te doen met moderne data- en AI-technologieën in een omgeving waarin leren en samenwerken centraal staan. Als Data/AI Engineer werk je mee aan het realiseren van schaalbare data- en AI-oplossingen. Je bouwt data pipelines, ontwikkelt AI-functionaliteit en helpt mee om oplossingen van idee naar productie te brengen. Daarbij werk je samen met ervaren collega's van wie je veel kunt leren, terwijl je zelf steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid krijgt binnen projecten. Je werkt op het snijvlak van data engineering, software engineering en AI-engineering. Je draagt bij aan het ontwikkelen, testen, deployen en beheren van oplossingen die betrouwbaar, veilig en toekomstbestendig zijn.

**In jouw rol:**

* Ontwikkel en beheer je data-, AI- en GenAI-oplossingen van Proof of Value tot productie
* Bouw je data pipelines, AI-services en API-integraties die betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en onderhoudbaar zijn
* Werk je aan AI-agents, retrieval-oplossingen, agent orchestration en andere moderne AI-patronen.
* Integreer je AI-oplossingen met bestaande systemen, applicaties en processen binnen CZ
* Automatiseer je deployment-, monitoring- en beheeractiviteiten volgens DevOps- en MLOps-principes

* Draag je bij aan het verder ontwikkelen van het AI- en dataplatform van CZ
* Borg je kwaliteit, security, privacy en compliance binnen alle oplossingen.

**Jouw team**
-------------

### **Jij bent van groot belang**

Je werkt binnen een omgeving die volop in beweging is. Het Data Science Team is verdeeld in vier GenAI Teams, die elk in nauwe samenwerking met de business GenAI-oplossingen ontwikkelen. Je komt terecht in een multidisciplinair team met verschillende dataspecialisten, van product owner en business analist tot data scientist en Data/AI engineer. Samen ontwikkelen jullie GenAI-oplossingen voor een specifieke divisie. Je werkt dagelijks samen met collega's uit je team én met de business. Daarbij krijg je volop de ruimte om kennis op te doen, vragen te stellen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen het vakgebied.

Het speelveld waarmee je werkt:

* Een snel ontwikkelend AI- en GenAI-landschap
* Moderne cloud- en dataplatformtechnologie
* Een organisatie die volop investeert in data, AI en digitale innovatie.

**Jouw profiel**
----------------

### **Dit neem je mee naar onze organisatie**

Je bent een engineer die graag bouwt en nieuwsgierig is naar nieuwe technologie. Je vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken op te lossen en wilt jezelf verder ontwikkelen binnen data, software en AI. Daarbij begrijp je dat technologie pas succesvol is als deze waarde toevoegt voor gebruikers en de organisatie.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

* Een hbo- of wo-opleiding in Informatica, Software Engineering, Data Science of een vergelijkbare richting
* Ervaring met data engineering, data pipelines en cloudplatformen
* Kennis van AI-, machine learning- en/of GenAI-toepassingen
* Ervaring met softwareontwikkeling in Python
* Ervaring met DevOps-, CI/CD- en automatiseringsprincipes
* Ervaring met SQL en het werken met grote datasets
* Affiniteit met platformontwikkeling, API's en schaalbare architecturen.

### **Onze vragen**

#### **Een motivatiebrief is niet nodig, in plaats daarvan ontvangen we graag jouw antwoord op de volgende drie vragen:**

* Beschrijf een data-, software- of AI-project waar je aan hebt gewerkt. Wat was jouw bijdrage en wat heb je daarvan geleerd?
* Vertel over een technische uitdaging die je tijdens een project bent tegengekomen. Hoe heb je deze aangepakt en welke afwegingen heb je daarbij gemaakt?
* Welke ontwikkeling binnen AI of generatieve AI vind jij momenteel het meest interessant? Leg uit waarom je denkt dat deze ontwikkeling relevant kan zijn voor organisaties zoals CZ.

jobs.title: Data Analyst Decision Troopers
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Lely, founded in 1948, is committed to creating a sustainable, profitable, and enjoyable future in agriculture. Driven by the challenges farmers face and the needs of cows, we develop high-quality robots and data systems that improve animal welfare, flexibility, and productivity on dairy farms. Our mission is to support sustainable food production.

For more than 30 years, we have been a global leader in the sales and service of automated systems for successive generations of dairy farmers. Every day, we inspire our colleagues to provide customers with innovative solutions and to be a reliable partner for long-term advice and support. With our state-of-the-art Lely Campus in Maassluis and a worldwide network of dedicated Lely Centers offering tailored sales and service, Lely operates in more than fifty countries.

 **Job Description**

With more than 30,000 real-time users of our farm management platform, combined with data from thousands of robots, we have access to an enormous amount of data. But which data is actually available for future Data Science and AI applications? How complete and reliable is this information? And what critical data is still missing?

As a data specialist, you know better than anyone how to map complex data landscapes, assess data quality, and identify gaps and opportunities. You work closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers and domain experts to understand which data is required to unlock new insights, develop innovative Data Science solutions, and enable future AI capabilities. Based on these needs, you define data acquisition plans, identify opportunities to improve data quality, completeness, and consistency, and help guide efforts to collect missing information.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills are essential, as you will collaborate with teams across the organization to connect business needs with data opportunities. If you enjoy bringing people together, uncovering what data is needed to solve tomorrow's challenges, and helping shape the foundation for future innovations in dairy farming, this role is for you.

 **Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.
* At least 3 years of experience in Data Roles with focus on Data Availability and Data Management.
* Experience working with data using SQL and Python.
* Pragmatic, can-do mindset, with a strong focus on delivering tangible results.
* A proactive attitude; you take initiative rather than wait for direction.
* Comfortable operating in areas where requirements and solutions are not yet fully defined.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to connect business, product, and technical teams.

  
**Additional Information**

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You help make the agricultural sector more futureproof, and we ensure you have the space, resources, and support to do so.

* An international work environment that values collaboration, initiative, and diverse perspectives.
* A culture that encourages learning, experimentation, and ownership of ideas.
* Excellent employment conditions, including up to 8 weeks of vacation per year and a strong pension scheme.
* A salary range of € 5.000 – € 6.000 gross per month, with clear opportunities for growth within the scale.
* Full ownership of your own development, with access to a wide range of courses through the Lely Academy.
* Daily access to outstanding sports facilities at the Lely Campus: an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, basketball and volleyball courts, table tennis, and table football. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training and challenge your colleagues during an active break.
* Fresh coffee and tea from our own barista (with milk from our own farm) and a healthy, affordable company restaurant.

Work-life balance

* A healthy work-life balance thanks to our hybrid working policy: you work at least three days a week on Campus, with flexible hours and plenty of opportunity to spend additional time onsite (between 06:00 and 20:00).
* A free shuttle bus that takes you to and from the metro station in Maassluis, ensuring your workday starts and ends smoothly.
* And of course: we love to celebrate! Whether it’s an anniversary or the annual Christmas party. At Lely, we know how to do it. For an impression of our events, take a look at this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6WA3e0WHbxE

We are also proud that our vision and efforts have been recognized with the Rotterdam Entrepreneurs Award 2025.

Recruitment & selection agency, consultancy, and/or staffing agency?

We appreciate the interest, but we recruit all our candidates directly. We understand that as intermediaries, you want to present candidates for our great positions and contribute to our ambitions, but this is not how we have set up our recruitment process. This means that all unsolicited profiles offered on Lely vacancies will be treated as direct applications.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
As **Data Analyst,** you play a key role in driving data-informed decision-making across one of LYNX’s most strategic product and business domains.

We are looking for four Data Analysts to join one of our core squads: **Onboarding**, **Demand Capture**, **Client Experience**, or **Client & Product Integrity**.

* **Onboarding Squad:** Analyze and improve the customer onboarding journey to make it faster, smoother, and more efficient.
* **Demand Capture Squad:** Use data to understand customer interest and help turn prospects into qualified leads and customers.
* **Client Experience Squad:** Analyze client behavior, feedback, and platform usage to improve the trading experience, increase loyalty, and reduce churn.
* **Client and Product Integrity Squad:** Support smarter, data-driven compliance and due diligence processes tailored to client needs and risk profiles.

In this role, you will help turn data into actionable insights that improve client journeys, optimize commercial performance, strengthen compliance processes, and support better business decisions.

You will own the full lifecycle of data-driven discovery, from connecting and exploring data to modelling, visualizing, and deploying solutions. Your work will directly influence how we grow, serve, and protect our clients.

**What you’ll do**

* End-to-End Analytics Ownership: Own the full process of data-driven discovery, from sourcing and exploring data to modelling, dashboarding, and delivering scalable solutions.

* Business Problem Solving: Translate complex business challenges into practical, data-based solutions that create measurable impact.

* Dashboard & KPI Development: Build dashboards, reporting frameworks, and tracking models that support decision-making and performance management over time.

* Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product, Marketing, Operations, Compliance, and Commercial teams to understand priorities and turn questions into insights.

* Data Exploration & Insight Generation: Analyze structured and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, risks, opportunities, and growth levers.

* Experimentation & Optimization: Support testing, experimentation, and continuous improvement initiatives with strong analytical input.

* Data Quality & Governance: Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reporting and analytics outputs.

* Squad Impact Contribution: Depending on your squad, contribute to improving onboarding flows, lead conversion, client loyalty, churn reduction, or smarter compliance processes.

**Who you are**

You are a curious and proactive analyst who enjoys solving business problems with data. You combine technical skills with commercial awareness and communicate insights in a clear and practical way.

* You have strong analytical skills and confidence working with structured and unstructured data
* You have solid Python and SQL skills, including advanced querying
* You have a proactive, self-driven mindset and take ownership of your work
* You communicate clearly and can explain complex topics in a simple way
* You have a high standard for quality and strong attention to detail
* You are comfortable working with cross-functional stakeholders
* You are motivated by continuous improvement and measurable impact

***Nice to have***

* Knowledge of financial markets and products such as options and futures
* Experience in fintech, brokerage, or other data-rich environments
* Experience with BI tools and dashboarding platforms
* Experience working in agile product squads

**What do we offer**

* A competitive salary
* a fixed 13*th* month;
* 8% holiday allowance;
* a pension scheme fully paid by LYNX;
* public transport travel allowance;
* home office equipment and home office allowance;
* continuous growth potential, including a personal training budget of € 2,000 per year to invest at your own discretion;
* daily lunch from our chef, beverages & fruit, Friday drinks at our own bar;
* Multiple trips & activities

**Who we are**

“LYNX helps you invest in yourself.”
  
“Working at LYNX means joining the LYNX family.”
  
“The development opportunities make LYNX the best place to work.”

This is what employees say about LYNX — and it reflects exactly what we aim to offer: an environment where you can get the best out of yourself.

From our offices in Amsterdam, Ghent, Berlin, and Prague, we work every day to provide private and professional clients with the best trading opportunities through a fast, user-friendly, and reliable platform.

LYNX is an international FinTech company where around 300 colleagues contribute to client success across Europe in an informal, collaborative, and growth-oriented environment.

We're an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified and eligible candidates without attention to gender identity/expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation/identity, disability or neurodiversity.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
Freelance CRM Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Turn complex customer data into practical growth strategies that help MR MARVIS expand across Europe from our Amsterdam HQ.

As Freelance CRM Data Analyst, you’ll help us understand who our customers are, how they behave, and what keeps them coming back. Sitting in the Customer Strategy team, you’ll build our reporting models, map cohort behaviors, analyze CLV drivers and killers and translate raw data into clear strategies that drive Customer Lifetime Value (CLV).

**About MR MARVIS**
-------------------

MR MARVIS is an Amsterdam-based menswear brand, dedicated to creating the perfect shorts, trousers and tops. As a Certified B Corporation, we’re proud to be part of a community of companies working together for change, and taking part in collective action to advocate for a shared goal of a global economy that benefits people and the planet.

What started in 2016 with three founders has now grown into a team of 300+ people representing 40+ nationalities. Having established a strong online presence across Europe, we’re now growing our international retail network. Today, you’ll find us in cities such as Amsterdam, Berlin, Paris and London.

We make slow fashion, with timeless design and craftsmanship at the centre. We are dedicated to doing better every day, creating value for our team, our suppliers, our customers, and everyone who interacts with our business.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Customer Intelligence & cohort mapping: Analyse customer buying behavior, repeat purchase rates, and lifecycle trends to map clear customer CLV cohorts and uncover growth opportunities.
* CLV & retention strategy: Extract practical insights on CLV drivers and killers from complex customer datasets to improve campaign structures, lifecycle flows, and long-term retention.
* Predictive & RFM analytics: Build and manage RFM models and segmentation frameworks to help marketing teams target the right customer segments effectively.
* Reporting architecture & automation: Design and maintain automated dashboards in modern BI tools (Omni), delivering clear CLV performance reports and score cards to leadership and cross-functional teams.

**What you bring**
------------------

**Essential**

* You charge an hourly rate of €90 - €115 and are available to work 24-32h per week for 3 months
* Strong hands-on experience as a Data, CRM, or BI Analyst within e-commerce, D2C retail, or consumer brands.
* A solid quantitative foundation through education or experience in Econometrics, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field.
* Skills and practical experience in using modern visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Omni, PowerBI) to build automated dashboards.
* Proven ability to analyze customer cohorts, repeat purchase rates, and lifecycle retention metrics.
* Hands-on experience with predictive modeling, RFM segmentation, and advanced CLV analysis.
* Practical mindset with the ability to explain complex data clearly to non-technical teams.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with CDPs, reverse ETL tools (e.g., Hightouch), or e-commerce migrations (e.g., Shopify).

MR MARVIS is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to nurturing an inclusive environment for all current and potential employees. A diversity of backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. So no matter where you’re from, who you love, or what you believe in, we welcome you to be your true self at MR MARVIS.

jobs.title: Data analist Mantelfoon
Finance & Data Analyst
jobs.description:
### **Help us build the finance function of the future**

Insify is looking for a Finance & Data Analyst who turns raw financial and operational data into clear, actionable insight, and who helps build how we do that. You get real ownership, a small team and a direct line to leadership. And the room to do it better than you are used to.

### **About Insify**

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.

Technology and data are in our DNA, and finance is where a multi-entity, multi-carrier business either holds together or does not. That is why we build our finance function ourselves, with people who know how it can be done better. That means you.

### **Your role**

**You are good at what you do.** You know how to reconcile a messy dataset, when a number deserves a second look and how to explain a discrepancy to someone who does not live in spreadsheets. What you are probably missing is influence over how that work is organised: the systems, the workflows, the good ideas that never make it out of an inbox.

**At Insify, that changes. You work at the intersection of finance, accounting and data.** You reconcile premium, commission and claims positions across our insurance carrier partners, build the dashboards and automations that keep our finance operations reliable, and flag anomalies before they become problems. You do this in a small, sharp finance team in a multi-entity, multi-carrier business, which means real responsibility from day one and direct contact with the finance and operations teams, and with leadership itself.

**You get a complete picture fast,** even when the data is imperfect, and you know when something needs to be driven to root cause and when it can be parked. You explain your findings clearly, to accounting, to operations and to the leadership team. And within your mandate you decide how you work: no bureaucracy, just your judgement and the freedom to act on it.

**The best part of this role:** you do not just report the numbers, you help redesign how the numbers come together. We use technology and AI to take the repetitive work out of your day (data extraction, first-pass pattern recognition, recurring workflows), so you can spend your time on the questions where a human really makes the difference: why does this number look wrong, what does it mean and what should we decide? You help determine what we automate, what we deliberately do not automate and how we strengthen our data quality and financial controls as the company grows. You build the solution, rather than handing it to another team.

**And building means building.** You write your own SQL to get to the data, your own Python to clean, reconcile and automate, and you use Claude and other AI tools as a matter of course to get there faster: drafting a query, debugging a script, turning a one-off analysis into a repeatable workflow. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do not wait for one either. Where something belongs in our production systems, you are the finance-side liaison to our data team and engineers: you translate finance's reporting needs into requirements they can build against, and translate what is technically possible or already available back to finance.

### **What you will do as Finance & Data Analyst at Insify**

* **Extract, clean and reconcile financial data** across our accounting, banking and carrier systems, including premium, commission and claims positions across multiple insurance carrier partners
* **Write your own SQL to query our data warehouse and financial systems**, and your own Python to clean, match, reconcile and analyse data that Excel cannot handle well
* **Build and maintain the scripts and small tools the finance team runs on**: reconciliation scripts, carrier statement parsers, checks that flag unreconciled items automatically, and pipelines that turn a one-off analysis into a repeatable, scheduled workflow
* **Use Claude and other AI tools** as part of your daily toolkit to write, debug and document your code, explore data and speed up analysis, while staying accountable for the result
* **Build and maintain dashboards and reporting tools** (for example in QuickSight and Excel/Sheets) that give the business real-time visibility into cash, receivables and payables
* **Identify trends, anomalies and unreconciled items** in financial datasets, and drive them to root cause rather than just flagging them
* **Support forecasting, budgeting and cash flow planning** with data-driven insight, including carrier-related working capital exposure
* **Automate recurring finance workflows** (for example via n8n) that connect our operational tools to our financial systems
* **Partner with accounting and finance** on VAT, insurance premium tax and other compliance-related reporting across our markets
* **Improve data quality, financial controls and reporting processes** as the company and its entity structure grow

### **Who you are**

* **You have a bachelor's degree**

Hoe komt een potje pindakaas eigenlijk op het schap van jouw lokale Albert Heijn terecht? Zet die vraag je meteen aan het denken over distributiecentra, vrachtwagens en bezorgroutes? Kun je je al voorstellen hoe planning, algoritmes en optimalisaties ervoor zorgen dat dit proces efficiënt en duurzaam verloopt?

Wil jij voor je scriptie of afstudeerproject zelfstandig onderzoek doen naar forecasting binnen een van de grootste supply chains van Nederland? In ons forecasting team krijg je de ruimte om een afgebakende onderzoeksvraag uit te werken en je resultaten in de praktijk te toetsen. Dit is een afstudeeronderzoek en geen meewerkstage.

Samen kiezen we aan het begin van de stage een onderzoeksvraag die aansluit bij jouw opleiding en onze praktijk. Daarna neem jij de regie over je onderzoeksplan, literatuuronderzoek, experimenten en conclusies. Mogelijke onderzoeksthema's zijn:

* Onzekerheidskwantificatie met conformal prediction: naast puntvoorspellingen betrouwbare voorspellingsintervallen ontwikkelen, zodat onzekerheid kan worden meegenomen in beslissingen over bevoorrading.
* Hiërarchische forecast reconciliation: forecasts op verschillende niveaus, zoals product-, winkel- en product-dagniveau, consistent met elkaar maken met methodes zoals MinT en OLS, of door reconciliation weights te leren.
* Lokale effecten beter voorspellen: onderzoeken hoe onze modellen specifieke patronen en omstandigheden per winkel of regio beter kunnen herkennen.
* Machine Learning Engineering op schaal: efficiënte methodes ontwikkelen voor featureselectie en hyperparameteroptimalisatie van modellen die op grote schaal worden gebruikt.

Hiervoor kun je technieken uit Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering en Operations Research combineren. Deze onderwerpen zijn indicatief. We horen ook graag welk onderbouwd idee jij zelf hebt voor een relevant afstudeeronderzoek binnen forecasting. Je levert een scriptie of afstudeerverslag op, aangevuld met een werkend prototype en een advies voor toepassing in de praktijk.

**Jouw nieuwe stage- en werkplek.**  
Je komt te werken in het Data Science - Operations team van Albert Heijn. Dit team maakt deel uit van de bredere Data Science & Analytics afdeling, waar meer dan 150 data professionals werken aan geavanceerde data-oplossingen om klantgedrag te begrijpen, klantrelevantie te verhogen en processen te optimaliseren. Samen met collega’s uit o.a. operations, replenishment en logistiek vertaal je data-inzichten naar concrete impact voor miljoenen klanten. Binnen het Data Science - Operations team werk je aan optimalisatie vraagstukken die onze supply chain en operatie efficiënt houden.

Tijdens deze stage werk je samen met data scientists, analysts, engineers en business stakeholders binnen Albert Heijn. Zij geven je toegang tot relevante kennis, data en bestaande modellen. Na een gerichte introductie werk je zelfstandig aan je onderzoek en zoek je proactief de juiste collega's op wanneer je input nodig hebt.

In deze functie werk je 32-40 uur per week, deels vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Zaandam en deels vanuit huis. Je krijgt daarbij begeleiding van een van onze ervaren collega’s.

**Dit bieden we jou.**

* Een afgebakend afstudeeronderzoek op het hoofdkantoor van Ahold Delhaize voor vijf tot zes maanden.
* Veel inhoudelijke vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen onderzoeksaanpak, planning en resultaat.
* Toegang tot relevante data, modellen en expertise van data scientists, analysts, engineers en business stakeholders.
* Een stagevergoeding (€500,- per vier weken) plus reiskostenvergoeding.
* Gezellige borrels en (netwerk)events met alle stagiairs binnen ons hoofdkantoor.
* Een inclusieve omgeving waarin je je op persoonlijk en vakinhoudelijk vlak continu kunt blijven ontwikkelen.

**Dit breng je mee.**  
Als grootste supermarkt van Nederland vullen we met onze 125.000 medewerkers dagelijks zo'n 7 miljoen borden. En als het aan ons ligt, doen we dat binnenkort ook samen met jou als onze nieuwe stagiair. Zeker als je de broodnodige proactiviteit en resultaatgerichtheid naar Albert Heijn meebrengt. Daarnaast:

* Volg je een master in Operations Research, Toegepaste Wiskunde, Data Science of andere relevante studie op dit gebied.
* Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met Python, statistische modellering en het zelfstandig uitvoeren van data-analyses of machine learning experimenten.
* Heb je sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, het vermogen om zelfstandig en in een team samen te werken en kun je helder communiceren om je ideeën duidelijk te presenteren.

We vinden het belangrijk dat jij bij Albert Heijn jezelf kunt zijn in een omgeving die openstaat voor verschillende perspectieven, een omgeving waarin we nieuwsgierig zijn en elkaar waarderen. Voor deze functie zoeken we bij voorkeur iemand die de diversiteit in ons team, in de breedste zin van het woord, versterkt. Iemand die vanuit eigen achtergrond en persoonlijke eigenschappen een ander geluid brengt en daarmee een goede aanvulling is op ons team.

**Samen beter eten bereikbaar maken. Voor iedereen.**  
Bij Albert Heijn geloven we dat eten en drinken een essentiële rol speelt bij de grote uitdagingen in de maatschappij. Het levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan een gezonde levensstijl, het verbindt mensen en draagt bij aan een beter klimaat en daarmee een duurzame samenleving. Onze missie is dan ook: Samen beter eten bereikbaar maken. Voor iedereen.

jobs.title: Data Analyst – Facility & Maintenance Analytics
jobs.description:
This Is What Your Role Looks Like

Are you excited about turning building and facility data into insights that make a real difference to how our clubs run? Are you able to spot a recurring issue in a mountain of maintenance data and translate it into a number a manager can act on?

Our Facility Team is expanding, and we're looking for a Data Analyst - Facility & Maintenance Analytics who will help our Facility Department make the most out of data and take club performance to the next level. You'll turn raw Facility & Maintenance data - starting with facility ticket data (preventive and corrective maintenance) and financial data - into standing dashboards, flagged issues, and cost/impact figures.

Your Responsibilities

* Analyze existing facility ticket, maintenance, and financial data (mainly in Databricks) to identify recurring issues, root causes, and cost drivers.
* Build and maintain dashboards, so managers have a standing, self-serve overview instead of one-off analyses.
* Flag day-to-day issues and anomalies for the responsible managers to investigate and act on.
* Evaluate the cost impact of processes and supplier performance (SLA adherence, benchmarking between suppliers, cost-per-intervention on recurring assets).
* Write your own SQL queries and build new views and aggregations on existing data.
* Grow into new projects as the long-term data-landscape approach makes more club data available.

Your Team

You'll join the central Facility Team and work closely with the Data Platform Team that maintains the underlying Databricks environment. Together, you turn facility and maintenance data into insights that facility managers and club operations can act on.

Who Are You

You're an analytical thinker who can digest complex maintenance and cost data, spot trends versus noise, and translate them into a clear signal for non-technical stakeholders such as facility managers. You're a self-starter and proactive in flagging issues, without pulling the decision or the fix toward yourself.

Additionally, we're looking for someone who has:

* A completed Bachelor's or Master's degree (HBO/WO) - in a quantitative, business, or technical field, or equivalent hands-on analytics experience.
* Knowledge of and experience with data related to buildings and Facility Management (e.g. maintenance, ticketing, asset, or supplier/SLA data) - a requirement for this role.
* Affinity with cost and financial analysis (cost-per-intervention, benchmarking).
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with a modern data platform (e.g. Databricks) or a comparable BI/data warehouse environment.
* Experience building and maintaining dashboards (e.g. Power BI) and a solid grasp of basic statistical/trend analysis.
* Experience independently building your own views/aggregations on existing data.

What We Offer You

At Basic-Fit, it's not just about work, it's about your growth. As a Data Analyst - Facility & Maintenance Analytics, you'll have the freedom to make an impact and develop yourself in a dynamic environment.

What you can expect from us:

* Learning & Development: Unlimited access to GoodHabitz and LinkedIn Learning.
* Career Growth: Plenty of opportunities for professional and personal development.
* Work Culture: An informal, international, and down-to-earth environment. We value working together, so we work 4 days in the office, 1 day from home.
* Innovation: Your ideas contribute to strategic projects.
* Salary: A monthly gross salary between €3.500 and €5.500 based on 40 hours, depending on your experience and background.
* Perks & Benefits: Travel allowance, bike plan, health insurance discounts, remote work allowance, and a pension plan (52% contribution by Basic-Fit).
* Fitness: Access to our gym at HQ.

About Basic-Fit

Basic-Fit is Europe's leader in the value-for-money fitness market, with more than 4.7 million members across 1,650+ clubs in 6 countries. We are continuously growing and improving. If you're looking for a place where you can make an impact while having fun at work, you've come to the right place!

What Makes Us Unique?

* Work with Impact: What you do makes a difference. We don't just work for our members, partners, and teams - we work with them.
* Collaboration: Everyone works together to achieve goals and celebrate success.
* Diversity & Inclusion: We welcome everyone into our workplace.

Apply Now!

Ready for your next adventure? Click the Apply button, and we'll get in touch with you as soon as possible.

Questions? Feel free to contact Yara van Bodegom at yara.vanbodegom@basic-fit.com.
